  Background:
    Given following users exist:
      | email             |
      | bob@bob.bob       |
      | alice@alice.alice |

  Scenario: changing my password while signed in
    When I sign in as "bob@bob.bob"
    And I go to the edit password page
    And I fill in the following:
      | current_password      | password |
      | new_password          | newpass1 |
      | password_confirmation | newpass1 |
    And I press "update_password"

    Then I should see "Your password has been changed successfully."
    And I should be on the sign in page

    When I sign in as "bob@bob.bob" with password "newpass1"
    Then I should be on the stream page

  Scenario: changing my password with invalid input
    When I sign in as "bob@bob.bob"
    And I go to the edit password page
    And I fill in the following:
      | current_password      | password |
      | new_password          | short    |
      | password_confirmation | short2   |
    And I press "update_password"

    Then I should see "Password is too short"
    And I should see "Password confirmation doesn't match"
    And I should be on the edit password page

  Scenario: requesting a password reset with a registered email
    When I go to the forgot password page
    And I fill in "email" with "bob@bob.bob"
    And I press "reset_password"

    Then I should see "If that email address is in our system, you will receive a password reset link shortly."
    And I should have 1 email sent to "bob@bob.bob"

  Scenario: requesting a password reset with an invalid email format
    When I go to the forgot password page
    And I fill in "email" with "not-an-email"
    And I press "reset_password"

    Then I should see "If that email address is in our system, you will receive a password reset link shortly."
    And I should be on the forgot password page

  Scenario: resetting my password from the email link
    When I go to the forgot password page
    And I fill in "email" with "alice@alice.alice"
    And I press "reset_password"
    And I should have 1 email sent to "alice@alice.alice"

    When I follow the password reset link from the email to "alice@alice.alice"
    And I fill in the following:
      | new_password          | newpass2 |
      | password_confirmation | newpass2 |
    And I press "update_password"

    Then I should see "Your password has been changed successfully."
    And I should be on the sign in page

    When I sign in as "alice@alice.alice" with password "newpass2"
    Then I should be on the stream page

  Scenario: resetting my password with invalid input from the email link
    When I go to the forgot password page
    And I fill in "email" with "alice@alice.alice"
    And I press "reset_password"
    And I should have 1 email sent to "alice@alice.alice"

    When I follow the password reset link from the email to "alice@alice.alice"
    And I fill in the following:
      | new_password          | short  |
      | password_confirmation | short2 |
    And I press "update_password"

    Then I should see "Password is too short"
    And I should see "Password confirmation doesn't match"
    And I should be on the password reset page

@catalog_promotion @channel_pricing @product_catalog
Feature: Display catalog promotion prices only in the channels where the promotion is available
    In order to see the correct product price for my current storefront channel
    As a Visitor
    I want catalog promotion prices to be shown only in channels where the promotion is configured

    Background:
        Given the store operates multiple channels
        And the "US Web Store" channel has hostname "us.example.com"
        And the "EU Web Store" channel has hostname "eu.example.com"
        And the "US Web Store" channel uses the "USD" currency
        And the "EU Web Store" channel uses the "EUR" currency
        And the store has a configurable product "Classic T-Shirt"
        And the product "Classic T-Shirt" has a variant "Classic T-Shirt - Small"
        And the product "Classic T-Shirt" has a variant "Classic T-Shirt - Medium"
        And the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Small" has price "20.00" in the "US Web Store" channel
        And the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Small" has price "18.00" in the "EU Web Store" channel
        And the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Medium" has price "22.00" in the "US Web Store" channel
        And the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Medium" has price "20.00" in the "EU Web Store" channel
        And there is a catalog promotion "Summer Sale"
        And the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" is available only in the "US Web Store" channel
        And the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" gives a "10%" discount on the product "Classic T-Shirt"

    Scenario: Visitor sees discounted and original prices in a channel where the catalog promotion is available
        Given I am browsing the "US Web Store" channel
        When I view the product "Classic T-Shirt"
        Then I should see the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Small" discounted price "18.00"
        And I should see the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Small" original price "20.00"
        And I should see the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Medium" discounted price "19.80"
        And I should see the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Medium" original price "22.00"
        And I should see that the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" is applied

    Scenario: Visitor sees regular channel prices in a channel where the catalog promotion is not available
        Given I am browsing the "EU Web Store" channel
        When I view the product "Classic T-Shirt"
        Then I should see the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Small" price "18.00"
        And I should see the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Medium" price "20.00"
        And I should not see any original price for the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Small"
        And I should not see any original price for the variant "Classic T-Shirt - Medium"
        And I should not see any catalog promotion applied

Feature: Automatically applying catalog promotions to newly created products and variants
    In order to show the correct discounted prices to visitors
    As a Store Owner
    I want catalog promotions to be automatically applied to newly created products and variants when they match the promotion scope

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a channel named "Web"
        And the store has a taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the store has a taxon "Winter Collection"
        And the store has a catalog promotion "Summer sale" that reduces price by 20% for products in taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the catalog promotion "Summer sale" is active in channel "Web"

    Scenario: Applying a catalog promotion to a newly created simple product in the targeted taxon
        Given the store has a simple product "Beach T-shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the product "Beach T-shirt" is assigned to taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the product "Beach T-shirt" is created in channel "Web"
        When a visitor views the product "Beach T-shirt" in channel "Web"
        Then the visitor should see the product price "$80.00"
        And the visitor should not see the original price "$100.00"

    Scenario: Applying a catalog promotion to a newly created variant of a configurable product in the targeted taxon
        Given the store has a configurable product "Summer Hoodie" priced at "$120.00"
        And the product "Summer Hoodie" belongs to taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the store has a variant "Summer Hoodie - Blue / M" for product "Summer Hoodie" priced at "$120.00"
        And the variant "Summer Hoodie - Blue / M" is created in channel "Web"
        When a visitor views the product "Summer Hoodie" in channel "Web"
        Then the visitor should see the product price "$96.00"
        And the visitor should not see the original price "$120.00"

    Scenario: Not applying a catalog promotion to a newly created variant when the parent product is outside the targeted taxon
        Given the store has a configurable product "Winter Hoodie" priced at "$120.00"
        And the product "Winter Hoodie" belongs to taxon "Winter Collection"
        And the store has a variant "Winter Hoodie - Black / M" for product "Winter Hoodie" priced at "$120.00"
        And the variant "Winter Hoodie - Black / M" is created in channel "Web"
        When a visitor views the product "Winter Hoodie" in channel "Web"
        Then the visitor should see the product price "$120.00"
        And the visitor should not see any discounted price

Feature: Protect completed orders from stale cart page modifications
  As a customer
  I want the cart page to prevent any modifications once my order has already been completed in the background
  So that I cannot accidentally mutate or corrupt a completed order by interacting with a stale cart page

  Background:
    Given there is a product "T-Shirt" priced at "$20.00"
    And there is a customer user "john@example.com"
    And the customer has an active cart containing 1 "T-Shirt"

  @ui @javascript
  Scenario: Clearing a stale cart page does not affect a completed order
    Given I am on the cart page
    And my cart page shows 1 "T-Shirt"
    When my order is completed in the background
    And I clear the cart on the stale cart page
    Then the completed order should still exist in the database
    And the completed order checkout state should be "completed"
    And the completed order should still contain 1 "T-Shirt"
    And the cart page should not remove items from the completed order

  @ui @javascript
  Scenario: Removing an item from a stale cart page does not affect a completed order
    Given I am on the cart page
    And my cart page shows 1 "T-Shirt"
    When my order is completed in the background
    And I remove the "T-Shirt" from the stale cart page
    Then the completed order should still exist in the database
    And the completed order checkout state should be "completed"
    And the completed order should still contain 1 "T-Shirt"
    And the completed order should not be modified by the removal action

  @ui @javascript
  Scenario: Increasing quantity on a stale cart page does not affect a completed order
    Given I am on the cart page
    And my cart page shows 1 "T-Shirt"
    When my order is completed in the background
    And I increase the quantity of "T-Shirt" to 2 on the stale cart page
    Then the completed order should still exist in the database
    And the completed order checkout state should be "completed"
    And the completed order should still contain 1 "T-Shirt"
    And the quantity of "T-Shirt" in the completed order should remain 1

  @ui @javascript
  Scenario: Reloading the cart page after completion still prevents cart mutations
    Given I am on the cart page
    And my cart page shows 1 "T-Shirt"
    When my order is completed in the background
    And I reload the cart page
    And I attempt to clear the cart
    Then the completed order should still exist in the database
    And the completed order checkout state should be "completed"
    And the completed order should still contain 1 "T-Shirt"
    And no cart mutation should be applied to the completed order

@cart @promotion @taxon_discount
Feature: Cart discount based on promoted taxon and minimum spend
    As a customer
    I want to receive discounts on my cart when I buy enough products from a promoted taxon
    So that I can pay less for eligible purchases

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And the store has a taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the store has a taxon "Winter Collection"
        And the store has a product "Beach T-shirt" in taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the store has a product "Sunglasses" in taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the store has a product "Winter Hat" in taxon "Winter Collection"
        And the store has a product "Scarf" in taxon "Winter Collection"
        And the product "Beach T-shirt" has a price of "$30.00"
        And the product "Sunglasses" has a price of "$25.00"
        And the product "Winter Hat" has a price of "$40.00"
        And the product "Scarf" has a price of "$20.00"

    Scenario: Apply a fixed discount when the cart contains enough products from the promoted taxon
        Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount" with a fixed discount of "$10.00"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" applies to taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum taxon total of "$50.00"
        And I have product "Beach T-shirt" in my cart
        And I have product "Sunglasses" in my cart
        When I view my cart
        Then I should see a discount of "$10.00" applied to my order
        And the order total should be "$45.00"

    Scenario: Do not apply a discount when the cart contains products from a different taxon
        Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount" with a fixed discount of "$10.00"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" applies to taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum taxon total of "$50.00"
        And I have product "Winter Hat" in my cart
        And I have product "Scarf" in my cart
        When I view my cart
        Then I should not see any discount applied to my order
        And the order total should be "$60.00"

    Scenario: Do not apply a discount when the promoted taxon total does not meet the minimum threshold
        Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount" with a fixed discount of "$10.00"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" applies to taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum taxon total of "$50.00"
        And I have product "Beach T-shirt" in my cart
        When I view my cart
        Then I should not see any discount applied to my order
        And the order total should be "$30.00"

    Scenario: Apply the discount once when multiple quantities of a promoted product meet the minimum threshold
        Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount" with a fixed discount of "$10.00"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" applies to taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum taxon total of "$50.00"
        And I have 2 units of product "Beach T-shirt" in my cart
        When I view my cart
        Then I should see a discount of "$10.00" applied to my order
        And the order total should be "$50.00"

    Scenario: Apply multiple promotions together when the cart qualifies for each promoted taxon
        Given there is a promotion "Summer taxon discount" with a fixed discount of "$10.00"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" applies to taxon "Summer Collection"
        And the promotion "Summer taxon discount" requires a minimum taxon total of "$50.00"
        And there is a promotion "Winter taxon discount" with a fixed discount of "$15.00"
        And the promotion "Winter taxon discount" applies to taxon "Winter Collection"
        And the promotion "Winter taxon discount" requires a minimum taxon total of "$60.00"
        And I have product "Beach T-shirt" in my cart
        And I have product "Sunglasses" in my cart
        And I have product "Winter Hat" in my cart
        And I have product "Scarf" in my cart
        When I view my cart
        Then I should see a discount of "$10.00" applied for promotion "Summer taxon discount"
        And I should see a discount of "$15.00" applied for promotion "Winter taxon discount"
        And the order total should be "$90.00"

Feature: Rich media previews in the publisher and stream
  As a user
  I want the publisher to automatically detect links I post and render rich media previews
  So that I can share and view rich media content directly within the stream without opening external links

  Background:
    Given I am logged in
    And I am on the home stream page

  Scenario: Secure supported oEmbed video link renders an embedded video player
    When I create a new post with the text "Check this out: https://secure-video.example.com/watch/123"
    And I submit the post
    Then I should see the post in the stream
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "Check this out:"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "iframe"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should not see the raw link "https://secure-video.example.com/watch/123"

  Scenario: Unsecure video link does not render a video player and shows raw link text
    When I create a new post with the text "Watch this: http://unsecure-video.example.com/watch/456"
    And I submit the post
    Then I should see the post in the stream
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "Watch this:"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "http://unsecure-video.example.com/watch/456"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should not see "iframe"

  Scenario: Unsecure rich-typed link from a non-secure oEmbed provider shows raw link text only
    When I create a new post with the text "Video-like content: http://rich-unsecure.example.com/media/789"
    And I submit the post
    Then I should see the post in the stream
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "Video-like content:"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "http://rich-unsecure.example.com/media/789"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should not see "iframe"

  Scenario: Direct photo link renders an image element in the stream
    When I create a new post with the text "Photo: https://images.example.com/photos/cat.jpg"
    And I submit the post
    Then I should see the post in the stream
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "Photo:"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "img"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should not see the raw link "https://images.example.com/photos/cat.jpg"

  Scenario: Link from a domain that does not support oEmbed is displayed as plain text
    When I create a new post with the text "Read this: https://plain-link.example.com/article/abc"
    And I submit the post
    Then I should see the post in the stream
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "Read this:"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should see "https://plain-link.example.com/article/abc"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should not see "iframe"
    And within ".stream_element:last-child" I should not see "img"

@managing_carts
Feature: Applying promotion coupons according to customer usage limits

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$12.00"
        And the store has a promotion "Holiday discount" with coupon "HOLIDAY10" and a discount of "$10.00"
        And the promotion "Holiday discount" has a per-customer usage limit of 1
        And the customer is logged in
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart

    @ui
    Scenario: Applying a valid promotion coupon to the cart
        When the customer applies coupon "HOLIDAY10" to the cart
        Then the cart total should be "$2.00"
        And the customer should receive a "$10.00" discount

    @ui
    Scenario: Applying a promotion coupon that has already been used in a completed order
        Given the customer has placed and completed an order using coupon "HOLIDAY10"
        When the customer applies coupon "HOLIDAY10" to the cart
        Then the customer should be informed that the coupon is no longer valid
        And no discount should be applied
        And the cart total should remain "$12.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Applying a promotion coupon after a cancelled order when cancelled orders are reusable by default
        Given the customer has placed and cancelled an order using coupon "HOLIDAY10"
        When the customer applies coupon "HOLIDAY10" to the cart
        Then the cart total should be "$2.00"
        And the customer should receive a "$10.00" discount

    @ui
    Scenario: Applying a promotion coupon after a cancelled order when cancelled orders are non-reusable
        Given the promotion "Holiday discount" treats cancelled orders as non-reusable
        And the customer has placed and cancelled an order using coupon "HOLIDAY10"
        When the customer applies coupon "HOLIDAY10" to the cart
        Then the customer should be informed that the coupon is no longer valid
        And no discount should be applied
        And the cart total should remain "$12.00"

Feature: Archive and restore shipping methods
    In order to keep obsolete shipping methods manageable
    As an Administrator
    I want to archive and restore shipping methods

    Background:
        Given I am logged in as an administrator
        And there are 3 active shipping methods:
            | code        | name              |
            | dhl         | DHL Express       |
            | fedex       | FedEx Priority    |
            | ups         | UPS Standard      |
        And there is 1 archived shipping method:
            | code        | name              |
            | old-post    | Old Post Service  |

    Scenario: Archive an active shipping method from the shipping methods list
        When I go to the shipping methods index page
        And I archive the "DHL Express" shipping method

        And I should not see the "DHL Express" shipping method in the active shipping methods list
        And I should see 2 shipping methods in the active shipping methods list

    Scenario: Filter the shipping methods list to show only archived shipping methods
        When I go to the shipping methods index page

        And I should not see the "DHL Express" shipping method
        And I should not see the "FedEx Priority" shipping method
        And I should not see the "UPS Standard" shipping method

        And I filter the shipping methods list to show only archived shipping methods
        And I restore the "Old Post Service" shipping method

        And I should be redirected to the non-archived shipping methods list
        And I should see the "Old Post Service" shipping method in the active shipping methods list
        And I should see 4 shipping methods in the active shipping methods list

Feature: Applying promotion coupon based on customer usage history
    In order to receive the correct discount without exceeding the coupon usage limit
    As a Customer
    I want to apply a promotion coupon to my cart only when it is valid for my account

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"

        And the coupon has a per-customer usage limit of 1
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "PHP20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$80.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Applying a coupon that is still valid until the per-customer usage limit is reached
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off if order contains a coupon "PHP20"
        And the coupon has a per-customer usage limit of 2
        And I have already used coupon "PHP20" once in a completed order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "PHP20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$80.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Not applying a coupon after the customer reached the per-customer usage limit
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off if order contains a coupon "PHP20"
        And the coupon has a per-customer usage limit of 1
        And I have already used coupon "PHP20" once in a completed order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "PHP20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$100.00"
        And there should be no discount applied

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Counting a completed order toward the coupon usage limit
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off if order contains a coupon "PHP20"
        And the coupon has a per-customer usage limit of 1
        And I have already used coupon "PHP20" in a completed order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "PHP20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$100.00"
        And there should be no discount applied

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Not counting a cancelled order toward the coupon usage limit by default
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off if order contains a coupon "PHP20"
        And the coupon has a per-customer usage limit of 1
        And I have already used coupon "PHP20" in a cancelled order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "PHP20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$80.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Counting a cancelled order toward the coupon usage limit when cancelled orders are non-reusable
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off if order contains a coupon "PHP20"
        And the coupon has a per-customer usage limit of 1
        And the promotion treats cancelled orders as non-reusable
        And I have already used coupon "PHP20" in a cancelled order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "PHP20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$100.00"
        And there should be no discount applied

Feature: Seeing catalog promotion prices only in available channels

    Background:
        Given the store operates on multiple channels
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" with a variant "PHP T-Shirt - Small"
        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" has a price of "$20.00" in channel "United States"
        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" has a price of "$18.00" in channel "Canada"
        And the product variant "PHP T-Shirt - Small" has a price of "$20.00" in channel "United States"
        And the product variant "PHP T-Shirt - Small" has a price of "$18.00" in channel "Canada"
        And the store has a catalog promotion "Summer Sale" available in channel "United States" with a discount of "20%"
        And I am on the product page for "PHP T-Shirt" in channel "United States"

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the catalog promotion price in the channel where the promotion is available
        When I view the product page
        Then I should see the original price "$20.00"
        And I should see the discounted price "$16.00"
        And I should be informed that the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" is applied

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the regular channel price in the channel where the promotion is not available
        When I switch to channel "Canada"
        And I view the product page
        Then I should see the price "$18.00"
        And I should not see any catalog promotion applied

Feature: Like and unlike posts
  As a user of the social network
  I want to like and unlike posts
  So that I can show appreciation for content and see when others have liked my posts

  Background:
    Given I am signed in
    And there is a public post in the stream

  @stream @like
  Scenario: Signed-in user likes a public post from the stream
    When I click "Like" within ".stream"
    Then the action within ".stream" should change to "Unlike"
    And the post like count within ".stream" should be "1"
    And the liker's name should be shown on the post within ".stream"
    And notifications should be enabled for the post within ".stream"

  @stream @unlike
  Scenario: Signed-in user unlikes a previously liked post from the stream
    Given I have liked the public post within ".stream"
    When I click "Unlike" within ".stream"
    Then the action within ".stream" should change to "Like"
    And the post should have no likes within ".stream"
    And the liker's name should no longer be shown on the post within ".stream"

  @single-post @like
  Scenario: Signed-in user likes a public post from the single post page
    When I open the public post page
    And I click "Like" within ".post-interactions"
    Then the action within ".post-interactions" should change to "Unlike"
    And the post like count should be shown as "1" within ".post-interactions"
    And notifications should be enabled for the post on the single post page

  @single-post @unlike
  Scenario: Signed-in user unlikes a previously liked post from the single post page

    When I click "Unlike" within ".post-interactions"
    Then the action within ".post-interactions" should change to "Like"
    And the post like count should no longer be shown within ".post-interactions"
    And the post should have no likes on the single post page

  @owner-view

Feature: Preventing payment finalization when tracked stock is insufficient for an existing order
    In order to avoid confirming payments for orders that cannot be fulfilled
    As a Store Administrator
    I want to be prevented from finalizing an order payment when purchased items do not have sufficient stock

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the store has a product "PHP Mug" priced at "$20.00"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Blocking payment finalization when a previously purchased product becomes tracked with insufficient stock
        Given there is an order "000000001" placed by customer "John Doe"
        And the order contains 2 units of product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the order payment state is "New"
        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" becomes tracked in inventory with 1 available unit
        When I view the summary of order "000000001"
        And I try to mark the order as paid
        Then I should be notified that the payment could not be finalized due to insufficient stock
        And the order payment state should remain "New"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Blocking payment finalization when tracked inventory is lower than the ordered quantity
        Given there is an order "000000002" placed by customer "John Doe"
        And the order contains 3 units of product "PHP Mug"
        And the order payment state is "New"
        And the product "PHP Mug" becomes tracked in inventory with 2 available units
        When I view the summary of order "000000002"
        And I try to mark the order as paid
        Then I should be notified that the payment could not be finalized due to insufficient stock
        And the order payment state should remain "New"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Allowing payment finalization when tracked inventory is sufficient for the ordered quantity
        Given there is an order "000000003" placed by customer "John Doe"
        And the order contains 2 units of product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the order payment state is "New"
        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" becomes tracked in inventory with 2 available units
        When I view the summary of order "000000003"
        And I try to mark the order as paid
        Then the order should be marked as paid
        And the order payment state should be "Paid"

Feature: Prevent deletion of purchased product variants
  In order to keep historical order data accurate and consistent
  As a Store Administrator
  I want the system to prevent me from deleting a product variant that has already been purchased

  Background:
    Given the store operates with the "default" channel
    And there is a product "T-Shirt"
    And the product "T-Shirt" has a variant "T-Shirt / Medium"
    And a customer has placed an order containing the variant "T-Shirt / Medium"

  @ui
  Scenario: Administrator cannot delete a product variant that has already been purchased from the admin UI
    Given I am logged in as an administrator
    When I try to delete the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium"
    Then I should see a notification that the variant is currently in use and cannot be deleted
    And the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium" should still exist in the product catalog
    And the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium" should remain unchanged

  @api
  Scenario: Administrator cannot delete a product variant that has already been purchased through the API
    Given I am authenticated as an administrator
    When I send a request to delete the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium"
    Then the response should indicate that the variant is currently in use and cannot be deleted
    And the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium" should still exist in the product catalog
    And the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium" should remain unchanged

  @ui
  Scenario: Administrator can see that a purchased product variant remains available after a failed deletion attempt
    Given I am logged in as an administrator
    When I try to delete the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium"
    Then I should be redirected back to the product variant list
    And I should see the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium" in the list
    And I should see a flash message saying the variant is currently in use and cannot be deleted

  @api
  Scenario: Deletion of a purchased product variant is consistently blocked by the API
    Given I am authenticated as an administrator
    When I send a request to delete the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium"
    Then the response status code should be 422
    And the response body should contain "The product variant is currently in use and cannot be deleted"
    And the product variant "T-Shirt / Medium" should still exist in the product catalog

Feature: Seeing catalog promotion prices on product variants

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a configurable product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" has a variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium" priced at "$20.00"
        And there is an active catalog promotion "Summer Sale" that reduces the price by 25% for the variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium"

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the discounted price of an eligible product variant
        When I view the variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium"

        And I should see the discounted price "$15.00"
        And I should see the catalog promotion name "Summer Sale"

@managing_product_attributes
Feature: Creating a new text product attribute
    In order to define custom textual properties for products in the store
    As a Store Administrator
    I want to create a new text-type product attribute by specifying its code and name

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    Scenario: Creating a new text product attribute
        Given I want to create a new product attribute

        And I specify its code as "material"
        And I name it "Material" in "English (United States)"
        And I save the product attribute
        Then I should be notified that the product attribute has been created

    @ui
    Scenario: Preventing the administrator from changing the attribute type while creating a text attribute

        When I choose "Text" as the attribute type

        And I want to create a new product attribute
        When I choose "Text" as the attribute type
        And I specify its code as "fabric"
        And I name it "Fabric" in "English (United States)"
        And I save the product attribute
        Then I should be notified that the product attribute has been created
        And the product attribute "Fabric" should appear in the store

Feature: New visitor registration through the sign-up page

  As a new visitor
  I want to register for a new account through the sign-up page
  So that I can create my own account and start using the application

  Background:
    Given I am on the new user registration page

  Scenario: Visitor successfully creates a new account with valid information
    When I fill in "Username" with "newvisitor"
    And I fill in "Email" with "newvisitor@example.com"
    And I fill in "Password" with "password123"
    And I fill in "Password confirmation" with "password123"
    And I press "Create account"
    Then I should be redirected to the getting started page
    And I should see "Getting started"
    And I should see the getting started page contents

  Scenario: Visitor sees a closed signups message when registrations are disabled
    Given open registrations are closed
    When I go to the new user registration page
    Then I should see "Open signups are closed at this time"
    And I should not see "Create account"

  Scenario: Visitor cannot create an account when registrations are closed after filling the form
    Given open registrations are closed
    And I am on the new user registration page
    When I fill in "Username" with "blockedvisitor"
    And I fill in "Email" with "blockedvisitor@example.com"
    And I fill in "Password" with "password123"
    And I fill in "Password confirmation" with "password123"
    And I press "Create account"
    Then I should see "Open signups are closed at this time"
    And I should not be on the getting started page
    And no account should be created

Feature: Manage contacts and aspects
  As a user
  I want to manage my contacts by creating, editing, renaming, deleting, and organizing them into aspects
  So that I can easily categorize my contacts and control how I share content with different groups of people

  Background:
    Given I am logged in
    And I am on the contacts page

  @aspects @create
  Scenario: Create a new aspect from the contacts page
    When I click ".new_aspect_link"
    And I fill in "aspect_name" with "Friends"
    And I press "Create aspect"
    Then I should see "Friends" in the aspect navigation list

  @aspects @create
  Scenario: Create a new aspect from the aspects page
    Given I am on the aspects page
    When I click ".new_aspect_link"
    And I fill in "aspect_name" with "Family"
    And I press "Create aspect"
    Then I should see "Family" in the aspect navigation list

  @aspects @delete
  Scenario: Delete an existing aspect from the contacts page
    Given an aspect named "Coworkers" exists
    When I click ".aspect_navigation .aspect[data-name='Coworkers'] .delete_aspect"
    And I accept the confirmation prompt
    Then I should not see "Coworkers" in the aspect navigation list

  @aspects @delete
  Scenario: Delete an existing aspect from the aspects page
    Given an aspect named "Book Club" exists
    And I am on the aspects page
    When I click ".aspect[data-name='Book Club'] .delete_aspect"
    And I accept the confirmation prompt
    Then I should not see "Book Club" in the aspect navigation list

  @contacts @aspects @membership
  Scenario: Add a contact to a specific aspect
    Given an aspect named "Friends" exists
    And a contact named "Alice Smith" exists
    And I am on the contact page for "Alice Smith"
    When I click ".aspect_checkbox[data-aspect-name='Friends']"
    Then the contact count for aspect "Friends" should increase by 1

  @contacts @aspects @membership
  Scenario: Remove a contact from a specific aspect
    Given an aspect named "Friends" exists
    And a contact named "Alice Smith" is in aspect "Friends"
    And I am on the contact page for "Alice Smith"
    When I click ".aspect_checkbox[data-aspect-name='Friends']"
    Then the contact count for aspect "Friends" should decrease by 1

  @aspects @rename
  Scenario: Rename an existing aspect
    Given an aspect named "Old Name" exists
    When I click ".aspect[data-name='Old Name'] .edit_aspect"
    And I fill in "aspect_name" with "New Name"
    And I press "Save changes"
    Then I should see "New Name" in the aspect navigation list
    And I should not see "Old Name" in the aspect navigation list

  @aspects @reorder
  Scenario: Reorder aspects and persist the new order
    Given the following aspects exist in order:
      | name       |
      | Friends    |
      | Family     |
      | Coworkers  |
    When I drag ".aspect[data-name='Coworkers']" to position before ".aspect[data-name='Friends']"
    Then the aspect navigation list should be ordered as:
      | name       |
      | Coworkers  |
      | Friends    |
      | Family     |
    When I navigate away from the contacts page
    And I return to the contacts page
    Then the aspect navigation list should be ordered as:
      | name       |
      | Coworkers  |
      | Friends    |
      | Family     |

Feature: Aspect navigation menu selection is remembered across pages
  As a diaspora user
  I want to use the aspect navigation menu to select and deselect one or more aspects and have my selection remembered across pages
  So that I can filter which posts I see and target posts to specific aspects

  Background:
    Given I am logged in as a diaspora user
    And I have the following aspects:
      | name      |
      | Friends   |
      | Family    |
      | Work      |
      | Acquaintances |

  Scenario: All aspects are selected by default when opening the aspects page

    Then within ".aspect-navigation" I should see all aspects selected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Friends" selected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Family" selected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Work" selected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Acquaintances" selected

  Scenario: Selecting only one aspect shows only that aspect as selected

    And within ".aspect-navigation" I click on "Friends"

    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Family" unselected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Work" unselected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Acquaintances" unselected

  Scenario: Selecting multiple aspects adds to the current selection

    And within ".aspect-navigation" I click on "Friends"

    Then within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Friends" selected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Family" selected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Work" unselected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Acquaintances" unselected

  Scenario: Aspect selection is preserved when navigating away and returning via the stream page
    When I open the aspects page
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I click on "Friends"
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I click on "Work"
    And I go to the stream page
    And I return to the aspects page
    Then within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Friends" selected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Work" selected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Family" unselected

  Scenario: Aspect selection is preserved when navigating away and returning via the contacts page

    Then within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Family" selected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Friends" unselected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Work" unselected
    And within ".aspect-navigation" I should see "Acquaintances" unselected

Feature: Apply promotion coupons based on customer usage history
    In order to receive the correct discount
    As a customer
    I want to apply a promotion coupon to my cart only when it is valid for my account and usage history

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And the store has a product "T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the store has a promotion "10% off with coupon" with coupon code "SAVE10"
        And the promotion gives a "10%" discount on the cart

    Scenario: Logged-in customer applies a valid coupon and receives the configured discount
        Given the customer "john@example.com" has not used the coupon "SAVE10" before
        And the customer has "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SAVE10" should be applied to the cart
        And the cart total should be "$90.00"
        And the customer should receive a "10%" discount

    @ui @cart @promotion
    Scenario: Coupon remains valid for a customer until the per-customer usage limit is reached

        And the customer has "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SAVE10" should be applied to the cart
        And the cart total should be "$90.00"

    @ui @cart @promotion
    Scenario: Customer cannot receive the discount again after reaching the per-customer usage limit
        Given the customer "john@example.com" has already used the coupon "SAVE10" 1 time
        And the customer has "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SAVE10" should not be applied to the cart
        And no discount should be applied
        And the cart total should remain "$100.00"

    @ui @cart @promotion
    Scenario: A completed order using the coupon counts toward the customer's usage limit
        Given the customer "john@example.com" has placed and completed an order using the coupon "SAVE10"
        And the customer has "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SAVE10" should not be applied to the cart
        And no discount should be applied
        And the cart total should remain "$100.00"

    @ui @cart @promotion
    Scenario: A cancelled order does not count toward the customer's usage limit by default
        Given the customer "john@example.com" has placed and cancelled an order using the coupon "SAVE10"
        And the promotion "10% off with coupon" is configured to ignore cancelled orders for coupon usage
        And the customer has "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SAVE10" should be applied to the cart
        And the cart total should be "$90.00"

    @ui @cart @promotion
    Scenario: A cancelled order counts toward the customer's usage limit when cancelled orders are non-reusable
        Given the customer "john@example.com" has placed and cancelled an order using the coupon "SAVE10"

        And the customer has "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SAVE10" should not be applied to the cart
        And no discount should be applied
        And the cart total should remain "$100.00"

    @ui @cart @promotion
    Scenario: Cart total reflects the discount amount when the coupon is valid
        Given the customer "john@example.com" has not used the coupon "SAVE10" before
        And the customer has "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
        Then the cart total should be "$90.00"
        And the discount amount should be "$10.00"

    @ui @cart @promotion
    Scenario: Cart total remains unchanged when the coupon is no longer valid due to usage limits
        Given the customer "john@example.com" has already used the coupon "SAVE10" 1 time
        And the customer has "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
        Then the cart total should remain "$100.00"
        And the discount amount should be "$0.00"

@managing_payment_methods
Feature: Sorting payment methods by position

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has payment methods "Bank transfer", "Cash on delivery", and "Credit card"
        And payment method "Bank transfer" has position 0
        And payment method "Cash on delivery" has position 1
        And payment method "Credit card" has position 2
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing payment methods sorted by position by default
        When I browse payment methods
        Then I should see payment methods "Bank transfer", "Cash on delivery", and "Credit card" in the list
        And the payment method "Bank transfer" should be the first in the list
        And the payment method "Credit card" should be the last in the list

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing a payment method without a position at the end of the list
        Given the store has a payment method "Mobile payment" without a position
        When I browse payment methods
        Then I should see payment methods "Bank transfer", "Cash on delivery", "Credit card", and "Mobile payment" in the list
        And the payment method "Mobile payment" should be the last in the list

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing a payment method with position 0 at the beginning of the list
        Given the store has a payment method "Apple Pay" with position 0
        When I browse payment methods
        Then I should see payment methods "Apple Pay", "Bank transfer", "Cash on delivery", and "Credit card" in the list
        And the payment method "Apple Pay" should be the first in the list

@managing_channels
Feature: Creating a sales channel with a menu taxon
    In order to sell products through specific channels using products from selected categories
    As an Administrator
    I want to create a new channel with a menu taxon

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store classifies its products as "T-Shirts" and "Mugs"
        And there is a taxon "Clothes"
        And there is a taxon "Accessories"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Creating a new channel with a menu taxon
        When I want to create a new channel
        And I specify its code as "WEB_US"
        And I name it "Web Store"
        And I set its base currency to "USD"
        And I make it available in locale "en_US"
        And I set its default locale to "en_US"
        And I choose "Order Items Based" as its tax calculation strategy
        And I select "Clothes" as its menu taxon
        And I add it
        Then I should be notified that it has been successfully created
        And the channel "Web Store" should appear in the channels registry
        And the channel "Web Store" should be saved with menu taxon "Clothes"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Creating a new channel with multiple available locales and a selected menu taxon
        When I want to create a new channel
        And I specify its code as "EU_STORE"
        And I name it "European Store"
        And I set its base currency to "EUR"
        And I make it available in locales "en_US" and "fr_FR"
        And I set its default locale to "fr_FR"
        And I choose "Order Items Based" as its tax calculation strategy
        And I select "Accessories" as its menu taxon
        And I add it
        Then I should be notified that it has been successfully created
        And the channel "European Store" should appear in the channels registry
        And the channel "European Store" should be saved with menu taxon "Accessories"

Feature: Hovercards on user names and avatars in streams

    Given I am on the stream page

    Then I should see a hovercard for "Alice Adams"
    And the hovercard should display "Alice Adams"
    And the hovercard should display the profile's hashtags
    When I move the mouse away from the hovercard
    Then I should not see the hovercard for "Alice Adams"

@catalog_promotions
Feature: Displaying discounted price for eligible product variants
    In order to show accurate promotional pricing without manual adjustments
    As a Store Manager
    I want catalog promotions to be automatically applied to eligible product variants

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a configurable product "PHP Hoodie"
        And the store has a product variant "PHP Hoodie - Medium" priced at "$100.00"
        And it belongs to "PHP Hoodie"
        And there is a catalog promotion "Winter Sale"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Displaying discounted price for an eligible product variant with an active catalog promotion
        Given the catalog promotion gives "20%" off on product variants of "PHP Hoodie"
        And I am viewing the product variant "PHP Hoodie - Medium"
        When I check the details of the product variant
        Then I should see the original price "$100.00"
        And I should see the discounted price "$80.00"
        And I should see the catalog promotion name "Winter Sale"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Displaying both original and discounted prices for a product variant with an applied catalog promotion
        Given the catalog promotion gives "15%" off on product variants of "PHP Hoodie"
        And I am viewing the product variant "PHP Hoodie - Medium"
        When I check the details of the product variant
        Then I should see the original price "$100.00"
        And I should see the discounted price "$85.00"
        And I should see the catalog promotion name "Winter Sale"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Displaying no discounted price for a product variant without an applicable catalog promotion
        Given the catalog promotion gives "10%" off on product variants of "Another Product"
        And I am viewing the product variant "PHP Hoodie - Medium"
        When I check the details of the product variant
        Then I should see the original price "$100.00"
        And I should not see any discounted price
        And I should not see any catalog promotion name

    I want to prevent duplicate tax category codes

        And there is a tax category with code "alcohol"

@applying_promotion_rules
Feature: Receiving discount based on total of items from specific taxon
    In order to pay less while buying goods with required total from promoted taxon
    As a Customer
    I want to receive discount for my purchase

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store classifies its products as "T-Shirts" and "Mugs"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And it belongs to "T-Shirts"
        And the store has a product "PHP Mug" priced at "$20.00"
        And it belongs to "Mugs"
        And there is a promotion "T-Shirts promotion"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving discount on order while buying product from promoted taxon which fits price criteria
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off if order contains products classified as "T-Shirts" with a minimum value of "$50.00"
        And I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$80.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving no discount on order while buying product from different than promoted taxon
        Given the promotion gives "$10.00" off if order contains products classified as "T-Shirts" with a minimum value of "$15.00"
        And I added product "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$20.00"
        And there should be no discount applied

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving no discount on order while buying product from promoted taxon which not fits price criteria
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off if order contains products classified as "Mugs" with a minimum value of "$50.00"
        And I added product "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$20.00"
        And there should be no discount applied

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving discount on order while buying multiple products from promoted taxon which fit price criteria
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off if order contains products classified as "Mugs" with a minimum value of "$50.00"
        And I added 3 products "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$40.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving discount on order while buying products from both of promoted taxons which fits price criteria
        Given the promotion gives "$10.00" off if order contains products classified as "T-Shirts" with a minimum value of "$50.00"
        And there is a promotion "Mugs promotion"
        And the promotion gives "$5.00" off if order contains products classified as "Mugs" with a minimum value of "$30.00"
        And I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I added 2 products "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$125.00"
        And my discount should be "-$15.00"

  I want to be prevented from marking an order as paid when a purchased item becomes stock-tracked and has insufficient inventory

  Background:

    And the customer has placed an order for 3 units of "T-Shirt"
    And the order payment state is "New"

  Scenario: Allowing payment finalization when tracked stock is sufficient

    And the administrator attempts to mark the order as paid
    Then the payment should be finalized
    And the order payment state should be "Completed"

Feature: Implicit OAuth authorization for third-party applications
  As a user of Diaspora
  I want to authorize third-party applications to access my account data through the implicit OAuth flow
  So that trusted apps can securely obtain my profile information without sharing my password

  Background:
    Given I am a registered Diaspora user
    And I am signed in
    And I have a valid OAuth application with client id "valid-client-id"
    And the application redirect URI is "https://app.example.com/oauth/callback"

  Scenario: Authorization request with an invalid client id or redirect URI returns an error
    When I visit the OAuth authorization endpoint with client id "invalid-client-id" and redirect URI "https://evil.example.com/callback"
    Then I should see an error message containing "Invalid client id or redirect uri"

  Scenario: Denying authorization does not include access tokens in the redirect URL
    When I visit the OAuth authorization endpoint with client id "valid-client-id" and redirect URI "https://app.example.com/oauth/callback"
    And I deny authorization for the application
    Then I should be redirected to "https://app.example.com/oauth/callback"
    And the redirect URL should not contain an access token
    And the redirect URL should not contain a token type

  Scenario: Approving authorization returns bearer tokens in the redirect response
    When I visit the OAuth authorization endpoint with client id "valid-client-id" and redirect URI "https://app.example.com/oauth/callback"
    And I approve authorization for the application
    Then I should be redirected to "https://app.example.com/oauth/callback"
    And the redirect URL should contain an access token
    And the redirect URL should contain token type "bearer"

  Scenario: Application can use bearer tokens to retrieve user info
    Given I have approved authorization for the application
    And the application has received a bearer access token
    When the application requests the user info endpoint with the bearer token
    Then the response should include my id
    And the response should include my username
    And the response should include my email

  Scenario: Authorization request with max_age requires re-authentication when the session is too old
    Given my last sign-in was more than "3600" seconds ago
    When I visit the OAuth authorization endpoint with client id "valid-client-id" and redirect URI "https://app.example.com/oauth/callback" and max age "3600"
    Then I should be prompted to sign in again before I can authorize the application

  Scenario: After re-authenticating and granting consent, the application can obtain tokens and user info
    Given my last sign-in was more than "3600" seconds ago
    When I visit the OAuth authorization endpoint with client id "valid-client-id" and redirect URI "https://app.example.com/oauth/callback" and max age "3600"
    And I sign in again with valid credentials
    And I approve authorization for the application
    Then I should be redirected to "https://app.example.com/oauth/callback"
    And the redirect URL should contain an access token
    And the redirect URL should contain token type "bearer"
    When the application requests the user info endpoint with the bearer token
    Then the response should include my id
    And the response should include my username
    And the response should include my email

@checkout_order_summary
Feature: Seeing items and quantities in the order summary
    In order to be certain about the contents of my order before placing it
    As a Customer
    I want to see the items and quantities in my order summary

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the store has a product "PHP Mug" priced at "$20.00"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Seeing all products and their quantities in the checkout summary
        Given I added 2 products "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I added product "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I proceed to the checkout summary
        Then I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "2"
        And I should see "PHP Mug" with quantity "1"
        And the checkout summary should display all products currently in the cart

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the updated order summary after adding more items during checkout
        Given I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When I proceed to the checkout summary
        And I add product "PHP Mug" to the cart during checkout
        Then I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "1"
        And I should see "PHP Mug" with quantity "1"
        And the checkout summary should reflect the items added during checkout

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Keeping the order summary accessible after completing checkout steps
        Given I added 2 products "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I added product "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I complete the addressing step
        And I complete the shipping step
        And I complete the payment step
        Then I should be able to access the order summary
        And I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "2"
        And I should see "PHP Mug" with quantity "1"

@catalog_promotions
Feature: Removing a catalog promotion

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$12.00"
        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" has a variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario: Removing the only catalog promotion
        Given the store has a catalog promotion "Summer Sale" applied to variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium"
        When I remove the catalog promotion "Summer Sale"
        Then I should be notified that the removal operation has started successfully
        And the catalog promotions list should be empty

    @ui
    Scenario: Removing an expired catalog promotion
        Given the store has an expired catalog promotion "Winter Sale" applied to variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium"
        When I remove the catalog promotion "Winter Sale"
        Then I should be notified that the removal operation has started successfully
        And the catalog promotion "Winter Sale" should be removed successfully
        And the variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium" should no longer be discounted

    @ui
    Scenario: Removing an active catalog promotion without time limits
        Given the store has an active catalog promotion "Flash Sale" applied to variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium"
        When I remove the catalog promotion "Flash Sale"
        Then I should be notified that the removal operation has started successfully
        And the catalog promotion "Flash Sale" should be removed successfully
        And the variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium" should no longer be discounted

    @ui
    Scenario: Removing an active catalog promotion within a defined time range
        Given the store has an active catalog promotion "Weekend Sale" applied to variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium" from "tomorrow" to "next Sunday"
        When I remove the catalog promotion "Weekend Sale"
        Then I should be notified that the removal operation has started successfully
        And the catalog promotion "Weekend Sale" should be removed successfully
        And the variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium" should no longer be discounted

    @ui
    Scenario: Removing a scheduled catalog promotion
        Given the store has a scheduled catalog promotion "Black Friday Sale" applied to variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium"
        When I remove the catalog promotion "Black Friday Sale"
        Then I should be notified that the removal operation has started successfully
        And the catalog promotion "Black Friday Sale" should be removed successfully
        And the variant "PHP T-Shirt - Medium" should no longer be discounted

    And I click ".publisher .poll-creator-toggle"

    And I click ".publisher .poll-creator-toggle"

    And I should see ".poll-creator .poll-option-remove:last-of-type"
    When I click ".poll-creator .poll-option-remove:last-of-type"

Feature: Apply promotion coupons with per-customer usage limits
  As a Customer
  I want to apply a promotion coupon to my cart only when it is valid for my account and usage history
  So that I receive the correct discount without exceeding the coupon’s per-customer usage limit

  Background:
    Given the store operates in the "United States" channel
    And the store has a customer account "john@example.com"
    And the customer "john@example.com" is logged in
    And the store has a product "Sylius T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
    And the customer has this product in the cart
    And the cart total is "$100.00"

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: Logged-in customer applies a valid coupon and receives the discount
    Given the store has a promotion "Summer sale" with coupon code "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion gives "$10.00" discount on the order
    And the coupon "SUMMER10" has a per-customer usage limit of 1
    And the customer has not used the coupon "SUMMER10" before
    When the customer applies the coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
    Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should be applied to the cart
    And the cart total should be "$90.00"
    And the customer should see a discount of "$10.00"

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: Coupon remains valid until the per-customer usage limit is reached
    Given the store has a promotion "Summer sale" with coupon code "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion gives "$10.00" discount on the order
    And the coupon "SUMMER10" has a per-customer usage limit of 2
    And the customer has used the coupon "SUMMER10" once before
    When the customer applies the coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
    Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should be applied to the cart
    And the cart total should be "$90.00"
    And the customer should still be allowed to use the coupon "SUMMER10" one more time

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: Customer cannot receive the discount again after reaching the per-customer usage limit
    Given the store has a promotion "Summer sale" with coupon code "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion gives "$10.00" discount on the order
    And the coupon "SUMMER10" has a per-customer usage limit of 1
    And the customer has already used the coupon "SUMMER10" once before
    When the customer applies the coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
    Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should not be applied to the cart
    And no discount should be applied
    And the cart total should remain "$100.00"

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: Completed order using the coupon counts toward the customer's usage limit
    Given the store has a promotion "Summer sale" with coupon code "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion gives "$10.00" discount on the order
    And the coupon "SUMMER10" has a per-customer usage limit of 1
    And the customer has a completed order that used the coupon "SUMMER10"
    When the customer applies the coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
    Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should not be applied to the cart
    And no discount should be applied
    And the cart total should remain "$100.00"

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: Cancelled order does not count toward the customer's usage limit by default
    Given the store has a promotion "Summer sale" with coupon code "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion gives "$10.00" discount on the order
    And the coupon "SUMMER10" has a per-customer usage limit of 1
    And the customer has a cancelled order that used the coupon "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion treats cancelled orders as reusable
    When the customer applies the coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
    Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should be applied to the cart
    And the cart total should be "$90.00"

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: Cancelled order counts toward the customer's usage limit when configured as non-reusable
    Given the store has a promotion "Summer sale" with coupon code "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion gives "$10.00" discount on the order
    And the coupon "SUMMER10" has a per-customer usage limit of 1
    And the customer has a cancelled order that used the coupon "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion treats cancelled orders as non-reusable
    When the customer applies the coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
    Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should not be applied to the cart
    And no discount should be applied
    And the cart total should remain "$100.00"

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: Cart total reflects the discount when the coupon is valid
    Given the store has a promotion "Summer sale" with coupon code "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion gives "$10.00" discount on the order
    And the coupon "SUMMER10" has a per-customer usage limit of 1
    And the customer has not used the coupon "SUMMER10" before
    When the customer applies the coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
    Then the cart total should be "$90.00"
    And the order summary should show a discount of "$10.00"

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: Cart total remains unchanged when the coupon is no longer valid due to usage limits
    Given the store has a promotion "Summer sale" with coupon code "SUMMER10"
    And the promotion gives "$10.00" discount on the order
    And the coupon "SUMMER10" has a per-customer usage limit of 1
    And the customer has already used the coupon "SUMMER10" once before
    When the customer applies the coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
    Then the cart total should remain "$100.00"
    And the order summary should not show any discount

@product_association_types
Feature: Prevent duplicate product association type codes
    In order to maintain data integrity in the catalog configuration
    As a store administrator
    I want to be prevented from creating a product association type with an already used code

    Background:
        Given I am logged in as an administrator
        And there is a product association type with code "related-products" and name "Related products" in locale "en_US"

    Scenario: Trying to create a product association type with an existing code
        When I want to create a new product association type
        And I specify its code as "related-products"
        And I specify its name as "Similar products" in locale "en_US"
        And I save the product association type
        Then I should see a notification that a product association type with this code already exists
        And there should be only 1 product association type with code "related-products"

            | postcode   | 10001         |
            | country    | United States |

            | last name  | Doe           |
            | street     | 123 Main Street |
            | city       | New York      |
            | postcode   | 10001         |
            | country    | United States |
        And I confirm the addressing step

    As an Administrator

        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"

        And the store has a catalog promotion "Summer sale"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Removing the only catalog promotion from the system

        Then I should be notified that the catalog promotion removal has started successfully
        And the catalog promotions list should be empty

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Removing an expired catalog promotion
        Given the catalog promotion "Summer sale" is expired
        When I remove the catalog promotion "Summer sale"
        Then I should be notified that the catalog promotion removal has started successfully
        And the catalog promotion "Summer sale" should no longer exist

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Removing an active catalog promotion without time limits
        Given the catalog promotion "Summer sale" is active
        And it has no time limits

        Then I should be notified that the catalog promotion removal has started successfully
        And the catalog promotion "Summer sale" should no longer exist

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Removing an active catalog promotion within a defined time range
        Given the catalog promotion "Summer sale" is active

        When I remove the catalog promotion "Summer sale"
        Then I should be notified that the catalog promotion removal has started successfully
        And the catalog promotion "Summer sale" should no longer exist

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Removing a scheduled catalog promotion

@managing_product_attributes
Feature: Creating select product attributes

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario: Creating a select product attribute with one value
        When I want to create a new select product attribute
        And I specify its code as "size"
        And I name it "Size"
        And I add the value "Small"
        And I save the attribute
        Then I should be notified that it has been successfully created
        And the product attribute "Size" should appear in the store
        And it should have the value "Small"
        And the type field should be disabled

    @ui
    Scenario: Creating a select product attribute with multiple values
        When I want to create a new select product attribute
        And I specify its code as "color"
        And I name it "Color"
        And I add the values "Red" and "Blue"
        And I mark it as allowing multiple options
        And I save the attribute
        Then I should be notified that it has been successfully created
        And the product attribute "Color" should appear in the store
        And it should have the values "Red" and "Blue"
        And the type field should be disabled

Feature: Track the total quantity of products in the cart
    In order to easily determine the number of products I’m about to buy
    As a Visitor
    I want to see the total quantity of items in my cart

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And there is a product "T-Shirt"
        And there is a product "Mug"
        And there is a product "Cap"
        And these products are available in the shop

    @ui @cart
    Scenario: Display the cart total quantity when a product is added to the cart
        When I add product "T-Shirt" to the cart
        Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to 1

    @ui @cart
    Scenario: Display a total quantity of 1 when one unit of a single product is added
        When I add 1 unit of product "T-Shirt" to the cart
        Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to 1

    @ui @cart
    Scenario: Display a total quantity of 2 when two units of a single product are added
        When I add 2 units of product "T-Shirt" to the cart
        Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to 2

    @ui @cart
    Scenario: Display the total quantity as the sum of all item quantities in the cart
        When I add 2 units of product "T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I add 1 unit of product "Mug" to the cart
        And I add 3 units of product "Cap" to the cart
        Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to 6

    @ui @cart
    Scenario: Update the cart total quantity correctly as products are added
        When I add 1 unit of product "T-Shirt" to the cart
        Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to 1
        When I add 2 units of product "Mug" to the cart
        Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to 3
        When I add 1 unit of product "Cap" to the cart
        Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to 4

Feature: Seeing the lowest price before a discount

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$12.00"
        And I am browsing the store

    @ui
    Scenario: Not seeing the lowest price before a discount when the product is not discounted

        Then I should not see the lowest price before discount information

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the lowest price before a discount when the product is discounted
        Given the product "PHP T-Shirt" has a discount and its current price is "$10.00"
        And the lowest price of product "PHP T-Shirt" in the last 30 days was "$8.00"
        When I view the product "PHP T-Shirt"
        Then I should see that the lowest price before discount is "$8.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Updating the lowest price before a discount as the price history changes within the last 30 days
        Given the product "PHP T-Shirt" has a discount and its current price is "$10.00"
        And the lowest price of product "PHP T-Shirt" in the last 30 days was "$9.00"
        When the product "PHP T-Shirt" had a lower price of "$7.00" 31 days ago
        And I view the product "PHP T-Shirt"
        Then I should see that the lowest price before discount is "$9.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Not seeing the lowest price before a discount after the discount is removed
        Given the product "PHP T-Shirt" has a discount and its current price is "$10.00"
        And the lowest price of product "PHP T-Shirt" in the last 30 days was "$8.00"
        When the product "PHP T-Shirt" returns to its original price of "$12.00"
        And I view the product "PHP T-Shirt"
        Then I should not see the lowest price before discount information

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the lowest price before a discount after the product drops below its original price again
        Given the product "PHP T-Shirt" returned to its original price of "$12.00"
        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" later dropped to "$9.00"
        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" has a new discount and its current price is "$8.00"
        When I view the product "PHP T-Shirt"
        Then I should see that the lowest price before discount is "$9.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Treating catalog promotions the same as manual price changes when calculating the lowest price before a discount
