        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" later had a manual price of "$8.00"
        And the product "PHP T-Shirt" has a discount and its current price is "$10.00"
        When I view the product "PHP T-Shirt"
        Then I should see that the lowest price before discount is "$8.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Not showing the lowest price before a discount when the feature is disabled for the channel

        And the lowest price of product "PHP T-Shirt" in the last 30 days was "$8.00"
        When I view the product "PHP T-Shirt"

Feature: Exclusive catalog promotions override other applicable promotions
  In order to show the correct discounted price on products
  As a store manager
  I want exclusive catalog promotions to override all other applicable promotions on a product
  So that customers see only the most relevant discount without stacking multiple promotions

  Background:
    Given the store operates in the "United States" channel
    And the store has a product "T-Shirt"
    And the product "T-Shirt" has an original price of "$100.00"

  Scenario: Exclusive catalog promotion overrides a regular catalog promotion on a product
    Given there is a regular catalog promotion "Summer Sale" applicable to product "T-Shirt" with a discount of "10%"
    And there is an exclusive catalog promotion "VIP Sale" applicable to product "T-Shirt" with a discount of "20%"
    When the customer views the product "T-Shirt"
    Then the product should be displayed with the original price "$100.00"
    And the product should be displayed with the discounted price "$80.00"
    And the discount should be based only on the exclusive catalog promotion "VIP Sale"
    And the regular catalog promotion "Summer Sale" should not be applied to the displayed price

  Scenario: The original price is displayed alongside the discounted price

    When the customer views the product "T-Shirt"
    Then the product should be displayed with the original price "$100.00"
    And the product should be displayed with the discounted price "$80.00"

  Scenario: Only the highest priority exclusive catalog promotion is applied when multiple exclusive promotions match
    Given there is an exclusive catalog promotion "VIP Sale" applicable to product "T-Shirt" with a discount of "20%" and priority "10"
    And there is an exclusive catalog promotion "Special Member Sale" applicable to product "T-Shirt" with a discount of "30%" and priority "5"
    And there is an exclusive catalog promotion "Flash Exclusive" applicable to product "T-Shirt" with a discount of "15%" and priority "20"
    When the customer views the product "T-Shirt"
    Then the product should be displayed with the original price "$100.00"
    And the product should be displayed with the discounted price "$80.00"
    And the discount should be based only on the exclusive catalog promotion "Flash Exclusive"
    And the exclusive catalog promotion "VIP Sale" should not be applied to the displayed price
    And the exclusive catalog promotion "Special Member Sale" should not be applied to the displayed price

@checkout_order_summary
Feature: Seeing items and quantities in the order summary
    In order to be certain about the contents of my order before placing it
    As a Customer
    I want to see the items and quantities in my order summary

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the store has a product "PHP Mug" priced at "$20.00"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Seeing all products and their quantities in the checkout summary page
        Given I added 2 products "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I added product "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I proceed to the checkout summary step
        Then I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "2"
        And I should see "PHP Mug" with quantity "1"
        And the checkout summary page should display all products currently in the cart

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the correct quantity for a single product in the checkout summary page
        Given I added 3 products "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I proceed to the checkout summary step
        Then I should see "PHP Mug" with quantity "3"
        And the checkout summary page should display all products currently in the cart

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the order summary reflect items added during checkout
        Given I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When I proceed to the checkout summary step
        And I add product "PHP Mug" during checkout
        Then I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "1"
        And I should see "PHP Mug" with quantity "1"
        And the checkout summary page should display all products currently in the cart

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Keeping the order summary accessible after completing checkout steps
        Given I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I completed the addressing step
        And I completed the shipping step
        And I completed the payment step
        When I reach the checkout summary page
        Then I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "1"
        And the checkout summary page should remain accessible

Feature: Apply promotion coupons with per-customer usage limits
  As a Customer
  I want to apply a promotion coupon to my cart only when it is valid for my account and usage history
  So that I receive the correct discount without exceeding the coupon’s per-customer usage limit

  Background:
    Given the store operates in the "United States" channel
    And the store has a customer account "john@example.com"
    And the customer "john@example.com" is logged in
    And the store has a product "Sylius T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
    And the customer has this product in the cart
    And the cart subtotal is "$100.00"

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: Logged-in customer applies a valid coupon and receives the configured discount
    Given the store has a promotion "10% off with coupon" with coupon code "SAVE10"
    And the promotion gives a "10%" discount on the order total
    And the coupon "SAVE10" has a per-customer usage limit of "1"
    And the customer has not used the coupon "SAVE10" before
    When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
    Then the coupon "SAVE10" should be applied to the cart
    And the cart total should be "$90.00"
    And the customer should receive a "10%" discount

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: A coupon remains valid for a customer until the per-customer usage limit is reached
    Given the store has a promotion "10% off with coupon" with coupon code "SAVE10"
    And the promotion gives a "10%" discount on the order total
    And the coupon "SAVE10" has a per-customer usage limit of "2"
    And the customer has used the coupon "SAVE10" "1" time in completed orders
    When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
    Then the coupon "SAVE10" should be applied to the cart
    And the cart total should be "$90.00"

  @promotion @coupon
  Scenario: A customer cannot receive the discount again after reaching the per-customer usage limit
    Given the store has a promotion "10% off with coupon" with coupon code "SAVE10"
    And the promotion gives a "10%" discount on the order total
    And the coupon "SAVE10" has a per-customer usage limit of "1"
    And the customer has used the coupon "SAVE10" "1" time in completed orders
    When the customer applies the coupon "SAVE10" to the cart
    Then the coupon "SAVE10" should not be applied to the cart
    And the cart total should remain "$100.00"
    And no promotion discount should be applied

@applying_promotion_rules
Feature: Receiving fixed discount on each unit of a promoted product
    In order to buy specific products at a reduced price
    As a Customer
    I want to receive a fixed discount on each unit of a promoted product in my cart

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the store has a product "PHP Mug" priced at "$20.00"
        And the store has a product "PHP Sticker" priced at "$5.00"
        And there is a promotion "T-Shirt promotion"
        And there is a promotion "Mug promotion"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving discount on a promoted product added to the cart
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off each unit of product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$80.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving no discount on a non-promoted product added to the cart
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off each unit of product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And I added product "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$20.00"
        And there should be no discount applied

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving discount on each unit of a promoted product added multiple times to the cart
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off each unit of product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And I added 3 products "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$240.00"
        And my discount should be "-$60.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Not reducing the cart total below zero when the fixed discount exceeds the item price
        Given the promotion gives "$10.00" off each unit of product "PHP Sticker"
        And I added 2 products "PHP Sticker" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$0.00"
        And my discount should be "-$10.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Applying fixed discounts only to the specified product in a cart with multiple products
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off each unit of product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I added product "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$100.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Applying different fixed discounts to different promoted products in the same cart
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off each unit of product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And there is a promotion "Sticker promotion"
        And the promotion gives "$2.00" off each unit of product "PHP Sticker"
        And I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I added 2 products "PHP Sticker" to the cart
        And I added product "PHP Mug" to the cart
        When I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$101.00"

@product_association_type
Feature: Preventing duplicate product association type codes
    In order to avoid duplicate product association types and maintain catalog data integrity
    As a Store Administrator
    I want to be prevented from creating a product association type with an already used code

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And there is a product association type "Related Products" with code "related_products"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario: Preventing creation of a product association type with an existing code
        Given I want to create a new product association type
        And I specify its code as "related_products"
        And I specify its name as "Accessories" for locale "en_US"
        When I try to create it
        Then I should be notified that a product association type with this code already exists
        And there should be only one product association type with code "related_products"

    @ui
    Scenario: Creating a product association type with a unique code
        Given I want to create a new product association type
        And I specify its code as "complementary_products"
        And I specify its name as "Complementary Products" for locale "en_US"
        When I try to create it
        Then I should be notified that it has been created
        And there should be one product association type with code "complementary_products"

@javascript
Feature: mentioning a contact from their profile page

  Background:
    Given following users exist:
      | email             |
      | bob@bob.bob       |
      | alice@alice.alice |

    When I sign in as "alice@alice.alice"
    And I am on "bob@bob.bob"'s page
    And I add the person to my "Besties" aspect
    And I add the person to my "Unicorns" aspect

  Scenario: opening the mention modal from a contact profile page
    When I press "#mention_button"
    Then I should see the mention modal

  Scenario: sharing a mention without changing aspect selection shares to all aspects
    When I press "#mention_button"
    And I fill in "status_message" with "Hello Bob!" in the mention modal
    And I press "Share" in the mention modal
    And I wait until ajax requests finished

    Then I should see a flash message containing "Your mention has been posted"
    And I should see "Hello Bob!" in "Besties"
    And I should see "Hello Bob!" in "Unicorns"

  Scenario: sharing a mention with only one aspect selected shares only to that aspect
    When I press "#mention_button"
    And I fill in "status_message" with "Hello Bob!" in the mention modal
    And I press the aspect dropdown in the mention modal
    And I uncheck "Unicorns" in the mention modal
    And I press "Share" in the mention modal
    And I wait until ajax requests finished

    Then I should see a flash message containing "Your mention has been posted"
    And I should see "Hello Bob!" in "Besties"
    And I should not see "Hello Bob!" in "Unicorns"

  Scenario: toggling aspects in the mention modal before sharing
    When I press "#mention_button"
    And I fill in "status_message" with "Hello Bob!" in the mention modal
    And I press the aspect dropdown in the mention modal
    And I uncheck "Besties" in the mention modal
    And I check "Unicorns" in the mention modal
    And I press "Share" in the mention modal
    And I wait until ajax requests finished

    Then I should see a flash message containing "Your mention has been posted"
    And I should not see "Hello Bob!" in "Besties"
    And I should see "Hello Bob!" in "Unicorns"

  Scenario: seeing a success flash message after sharing a mention
    When I press "#mention_button"
    And I fill in "status_message" with "Hello Bob!" in the mention modal
    And I press "Share" in the mention modal
    And I wait until ajax requests finished

    Then I should see a flash message containing "Your mention has been posted"

@cart @ui @visitor
Feature: Track the total quantity of products in the cart
  As a Visitor
  I want to track the total quantity of the cart
  So that I can easily determine the number of products I’m about to buy

  Background:
    Given the store operates on a single channel
    And there is a product "T-Shirt" available in the store
    And there is a product "Mug" available in the store
    And there is a product "Cap" available in the store
    And I am on the store homepage

  Scenario: Display the cart total quantity when a single unit of a product is added
    When I add product "T-Shirt" to the cart
    Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to "1"

  Scenario: Display the cart total quantity when two units of a single product are added
    When I add 2 units of product "T-Shirt" to the cart
    Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to "2"

  Scenario: Display the cart total quantity as the sum of multiple products with varying quantities
    When I add 2 units of product "T-Shirt" to the cart
    And I add 3 units of product "Mug" to the cart
    And I add 1 unit of product "Cap" to the cart
    Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to "6"

  Scenario: Update the cart total quantity correctly as products are added
    When I add product "T-Shirt" to the cart
    Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to "1"
    When I add 2 units of product "Mug" to the cart
    Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to "3"
    When I add 1 unit of product "Cap" to the cart
    Then I should see the cart total quantity equal to "4"

Feature: Reordering product images
    In order to control the display sequence of product images in the store
    As a store administrator
    I want to reorder the images of a product

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And there is a product "T-Shirt"
        And this product has the following images:
            | code   | type   | position |
            | image1 | small  | 0        |
            | image2 | medium | 1        |
            | image3 | large  | 2        |
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario: Reordering product images from the image management view
        When I browse the product "T-Shirt" images management page
        Then I should see the product image list with images ordered by position
        And I should see "image1" with type "small"
        And I should see "image2" with type "medium"
        And I should see "image3" with type "large"

        When I change the position of "image1" to "2"
        And I change the position of "image2" to "0"
        And I change the position of "image3" to "1"
        And I save the changes

        Then I should be notified that the product images have been updated
        And the product "T-Shirt" images should be ordered as follows:
            | code   | type   | position |
            | image2 | small  | 0        |
            | image3 | medium | 1        |
            | image1 | large  | 2        |

    @ui
    Scenario: Updating image positions and preserving the correct type labels
        When I browse the product "T-Shirt" images management page
        And I change the position of "image3" to "0"
        And I change the position of "image1" to "1"
        And I change the position of "image2" to "2"
        And I save the changes

        Then the product "T-Shirt" images should be ordered as follows:
            | code   | type   | position |
            | image3 | small  | 0        |
            | image1 | medium | 1        |
            | image2 | large  | 2        |
        And each image type should reflect its new position in the list

Feature: Submit a product review with valid required fields
    As a Visitor
    I want to submit a product review only when all required fields are valid
    So that I can avoid mistakes and ensure only properly completed reviews are accepted

    Background:
        Given the store has a product "T-Shirt"
        And the store has a customer account with email "customer@example.com"
        And I am on the product page for "T-Shirt"

    Scenario: Visitor starts reviewing an existing product
        When I click "Write a review"
        Then I should be on the product review page for "T-Shirt"

    Scenario: Visitor submits a review with all required fields valid
        Given I am on the product review page for "T-Shirt"
        When I fill in "Rating" with "5"
        And I fill in "Title" with "Great product"
        And I fill in "Comment" with "The quality is excellent."
        And I fill in "Email" with "visitor@example.com"
        And I press "Submit review"
        Then I should see a message that my review has been submitted
        And I should not see any validation errors

    Scenario: Visitor is notified when rating is missing
        Given I am on the product review page for "T-Shirt"
        When I fill in "Title" with "Great product"
        And I fill in "Comment" with "The quality is excellent."
        And I fill in "Email" with "visitor@example.com"
        And I press "Submit review"
        Then I should see a validation message "Please select a rating."

    Scenario: Visitor is notified when rating is below the minimum
        Given I am on the product review page for "T-Shirt"
        When I fill in "Rating" with "0"
        And I fill in "Title" with "Great product"
        And I fill in "Comment" with "The quality is excellent."
        And I fill in "Email" with "visitor@example.com"
        And I press "Submit review"
        Then I should see a validation message "Rating must be between 1 and 5."

    Scenario: Visitor is notified when rating is above the maximum

        When I fill in "Rating" with "6"

        And I fill in "Comment" with "The quality is excellent."
        And I fill in "Email" with "visitor@example.com"
        And I press "Submit review"

    Scenario: Visitor is notified when title is missing

        And I fill in "Comment" with "The quality is excellent."
        And I fill in "Email" with "visitor@example.com"
        And I press "Submit review"

@managing_orders
Feature: Having the account registration form prefilled after placing an order

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$12.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Having the registration form prefilled after completing checkout as a visitor
        Given the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And the customer proceeded to checkout and placed an order with email "john@example.com"
        When the customer views the thank you page
        Then they should be able to proceed to registration
        And the registration form should be prefilled with email "john@example.com"

    @ui
    Scenario: Not being offered registration after completing checkout while logged in
        Given the customer is logged in
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And the customer proceeded to checkout and placed an order
        When the customer views the thank you page
        Then they should see the thank you page
        And they should not be offered the option to proceed to registration

@javascript
Feature: mobile publisher

  Background:
    Given following user exists:
      | username    | email             |
      | Alice Smith | alice@alice.alice |
      | Bob Jones   | bob@bob.bob       |
    And I sign in as "alice@alice.alice"

  Scenario: Post to selected aspects from the mobile publisher
    When I go to the mobile main page
    And I enter "Hello mobile world" into the mobile publisher
    And I select "Friends" from the aspect dropdown
    And I select "Family" from the aspect dropdown
    And I click "Share"
    Then I should see "Hello mobile world" in the stream for "Friends"
    And I should see "Hello mobile world" in the stream for "Family"
    And I should not see "Hello mobile world" in the stream for "Work"

  Scenario: Delete a posted item from the stream
    When I go to the mobile main page
    And I enter "Delete me" into the mobile publisher
    And I click "Share"
    Then I should see "Delete me" in the stream
    When I delete "Delete me" from the stream
    And I confirm the deletion prompt
    Then I should not see "Delete me" in the stream

  Scenario: Upload a photo without text and share it
    When I go to the mobile main page
    And I attach "spec/fixtures/files/photo.jpg" to the photo drop zone
    Then I should see the upload complete
    When I click "Share"
    Then I should see the photo in the stream
    And I should see the photo in the stream for other connected users

  Scenario: Attach an invalid file, then attach and remove a valid photo before sharing

    And I attach "spec/fixtures/files/invalid.txt" to the photo drop zone

    When I remove the uploaded photo

    Then I should see the upload complete

    And I should see the attachment indicator in the text area

@order_payment @admin @gateway_cancellation
Feature: Order payment state returns to awaiting payment after authorized payment cancellation
    In order to allow customers to retry payment after an authorization is voided
    As an Administrator
    I want an order's payment state to return to "Awaiting payment" when an authorized payment is cancelled by the gateway

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And the store has a payment method "Stripe" with code "stripe" and gateway "stripe"
        And the store has a product "T-Shirt" priced at "$20.00"
        And the store has a customer "john@example.com"
        And the customer "john@example.com" has placed an order with 2 items of product "T-Shirt"
        And the order has 2 payments
        And the first payment is authorized
        And the second payment is completed
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui @javascript
    Scenario: Order payment state changes to awaiting payment after an authorized payment is cancelled by the gateway
        When the gateway cancels the authorized payment for the order
        Then the order payment state should be "Awaiting payment"
        And I should be able to view the order in the orders list
        And the order in the orders list should have payment state "Awaiting payment"
        When I view the order summary
        Then the order summary should contain 2 payments

    Then the cart total quantity should be 2

    Then the cart total quantity should be 1
    When I add 2 "Mug" to the cart
    Then the cart total quantity should be 3
    When I add 1 "Cap" to the cart
    Then the cart total quantity should be 4

Feature: Applying exclusive catalog promotion over other promotions on a product
    In order to show the correct discounted price for a product
    As a Store Manager
    I want exclusive catalog promotions to override all other applicable promotions on a product

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the store has a product "PHP Mug" priced at "$20.00"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Applying only exclusive catalog promotion when regular and exclusive promotions are both applicable
        Given there is a catalog promotion "Regular T-Shirt promotion" that gives "$10.00" off for product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And there is an exclusive catalog promotion "Exclusive T-Shirt promotion" that gives "$20.00" off for product "PHP T-Shirt"
        When I view product "PHP T-Shirt"
        Then I should see the original price "$100.00"
        And I should see the discounted price "$80.00"
        And the regular catalog promotion should not be applied

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Displaying original price alongside discounted price when exclusive promotion is applied
        Given there is an exclusive catalog promotion "Exclusive Mug promotion" that gives "$5.00" off for product "PHP Mug"
        When I view product "PHP Mug"
        Then I should see the original price "$20.00"
        And I should see the discounted price "$15.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Applying only the highest priority exclusive catalog promotion when multiple exclusive promotions are applicable
        Given there is an exclusive catalog promotion "Low priority T-Shirt promotion" that gives "$10.00" off for product "PHP T-Shirt" with priority 0
        And there is an exclusive catalog promotion "High priority T-Shirt promotion" that gives "$15.00" off for product "PHP T-Shirt" with priority 10
        And there is a regular catalog promotion "Regular T-Shirt promotion" that gives "$5.00" off for product "PHP T-Shirt"
        When I view product "PHP T-Shirt"
        Then I should see the original price "$100.00"
        And I should see the discounted price "$85.00"
        And only the "High priority T-Shirt promotion" should be applied
        And the other promotions should be ignored

Feature: New visitor registration through the sign-up page

  As a new visitor
  I want to register for a new account through the sign-up page
  So that I can create my own account and start using the application

  Background:
    Given I am not logged in

  Scenario: Visitor successfully creates a new account with valid information
    Given open registrations are enabled
    When I go to the new user registration page
    And I fill in "First name" with "New"
    And I fill in "Last name" with "Visitor"
    And I fill in "Email" with "new.visitor@example.com"
    And I fill in "Username" with "newvisitor"
    And I fill in "Password" with "password123"
    And I fill in "Password confirmation" with "password123"
    And I press "Create account"
    Then I should be on the getting started page
    And I should see "Getting started"
    And I should see "Welcome to Diaspora"

  Scenario: Visitor sees signups closed message when registrations are disabled
    Given open registrations are disabled
    When I go to the new user registration page
    Then I should see "Open signups are closed at this time"
    And I should not see "Create account"

  Scenario: Visitor cannot create an account when registrations are closed after filling the form
    Given open registrations are disabled
    When I go to the new user registration page
    And I fill in "First name" with "Blocked"
    And I fill in "Last name" with "Visitor"
    And I fill in "Email" with "blocked.visitor@example.com"
    And I fill in "Username" with "blockedvisitor"
    And I fill in "Password" with "password123"
    And I fill in "Password confirmation" with "password123"
    And I press "Create account"
    Then I should see "Open signups are closed at this time"
    And I should not be on the getting started page
    And I should not see "Welcome to Diaspora"

    As a Visitor
    I want to see catalog promotion prices only in channels where the promotion is available

    Background:
        Given the store operates on channels "United States" and "France"
        And the store has a configurable product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And it has a variant "PHP T-Shirt - Small"

        And the variant "PHP T-Shirt - Small" costs "€90.00" in "France"
        And there is a catalog promotion "Summer sale"

        And I should see the discounted price "$80.00"

        Then I should see the regular price "€90.00"

        When I view product "PHP T-Shirt" in "United States"

        And the catalog promotion gives "10%" discount on products in "France"

        And I should see the discounted price "€81.00"
        And I should see that the catalog promotion is applied

        And no discount should be applied to my cart
        And my cart total should remain "$12.00"

Feature: Credit Balance Refund and Repayment Reversal on Overpaid Loans

  @TestRailId:C76707
  Scenario: Verify Credit Balance Refund on overpaid loan clears outstanding and closes loan - UC1
    When Admin creates a loan product with overpayment and refund accounting enabled
    And Admin creates a client with random data
    And Admin approves and disburses a loan with principal 1000.00 and repayment schedule of 1 installment
    And Admin makes repayments that overpay the loan by 100.00
    Then Admin verifies the loan is in OVERPAID status with outstanding amount 100.00
    When Admin posts a Credit Balance Refund transaction for the full overpaid amount 100.00
    Then Admin verifies the loan status is CLOSED_OBLIGATIONS_MET
    And Admin verifies the outstanding amount is 0.00
    And Admin verifies loan transaction history contains DISBURSEMENT, REPAYMENT, and CREDIT_BALANCE_REFUND entries

@managing_products
Feature: Viewing non-translatable product attributes on the edit page

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "Iron Pickaxe" with a non-translatable percent attribute "crit chance" with value 10%
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing a non-translatable product attribute on the edit page
        When I want to modify the product "Iron Pickaxe"
        Then I should see the non-translatable attribute "crit chance" with value 10%

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing a non-translatable product attribute regardless of locale
        When I want to modify the product "Iron Pickaxe" in another locale
        Then I should see the non-translatable attribute "crit chance" with value 10%

Feature: Follow users and manage contact aspects safely
  In order to build meaningful connections and control interactions
  As a user of the social network
  I want to follow other users and manage my contact aspects while safely viewing their profiles

  Background:
    Given I am logged in as "alice"
    And I have a contact aspect named "Friends"

  Scenario: Malicious profile names are escaped in flash messages and page content
    Given there is a user with the profile name "<script>alert('xss')</script>"
    When I visit the profile page for that user
    Then I should not see any executed script
    And I should see the escaped profile name "<script>alert('xss')</script>"
    When I follow that user
    Then I should see a flash message containing the escaped profile name "<script>alert('xss')</script>"
    And I should not see the raw string "<script>alert('xss')</script>" in the flash message

  Scenario: Adding a contact to a newly created aspect updates both aspect counts without duplicating the relationship
    Given there is a user named "bob"
    And I am already following "bob" in the aspect "Friends"
    And "bob" has me in the aspect "Work"
    When I create a new aspect named "Gym Buddies"
    And I add "bob" to the aspect "Gym Buddies"
    Then the contact count for the aspect "Gym Buddies" should be 1
    And the contact count for the aspect "Friends" should be 1
    And "bob" should appear only once in my contacts list
    And the relationship between me and "bob" should not be duplicated

  Scenario: Viewing a user I follow who does not follow me back shows aspect name and mention only
    Given there is a user named "carol"
    And I follow "carol" in the aspect "Friends"
    And "carol" does not follow me back
    When I visit the profile page for "carol"
    Then I should see the aspect name "Friends"
    And I should see a mention option
    And I should not see a direct messaging option

  Scenario: Viewing a user who follows me but I do not follow back shows add contact only
    Given there is a user named "dave"
    And "dave" follows me
    And I do not follow "dave"
    When I visit the profile page for "dave"
    Then I should see an "Add contact" option
    And I should not see a mention option
    And I should not see a direct messaging option

  Scenario: Viewing a mutual contact added to multiple aspects shows all aspects and full interaction options
    Given there is a user named "erin"
    And I follow "erin" in the aspect "Friends"
    And I follow "erin" in the aspect "Work"
    And "erin" follows me back
    When I visit the profile page for "erin"
    Then I should see "All aspects"
    And I should see a mention option
    And I should see a direct messaging option

  As a finance system administrator
  I want to create, update, retrieve, and delete Working Capital Breach configurations with proper validation and dependency checks
  So that I can manage breach rules safely and ensure they cannot be misconfigured or removed while in use

  Background:
    Given the system is initialized with the following reference data
      | entityType | code | description |
      | Role       | ADMIN | System administrator with full configuration privileges |
      | Currency   | USD  | United States Dollar |
      | Currency   | EUR  | Euro |
      | Currency   | INR  | Indian Rupee |
    And the following Working Capital Breach configuration template is available
      | field                         | type     | required | allowedValues                         | defaultValue | notes |
      | name                          | string   | true     | any non-empty unique string           | null         | Must be unique across all breach configurations |
      | breachFrequency               | integer  | true     | > 0                                   | null         | Frequency interval for breach evaluation |

@cart @taxes @ui
Feature: Correct taxes are applied to cart items in the same tax category
    In order to see and pay the proper total amount for my order
    As a Customer
    I want taxes to be correctly calculated for products in the same tax category

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a channel named "Web"
        And this channel uses the "USD" currency
        And the default tax zone is "United States"
        And the tax category "Standard" exists
        And the tax rate "23%" is configured for the tax category "Standard"
        And there is a product "Taxed product A" priced at "$100.00" in tax category "Standard"
        And there is a product "Taxed product B" priced at "$30.00" in tax category "Standard"

    Scenario: Cart total and taxes are correct for one taxed product
        Given I have added 1 unit of product "Taxed product A" to the cart
        Then the cart total should be "$123.00"
        And the cart taxes should be "$23.00"

    Scenario: Cart total and taxes are correct for three units of the same taxed product
        Given I have added 3 units of product "Taxed product A" to the cart
        Then the cart total should be "$369.00"
        And the cart taxes should be "$69.00"

    Scenario: Cart total and taxes are correct for multiple taxed products in the same tax category
        Given I have added 3 units of product "Taxed product A" to the cart
        And I have added 2 units of product "Taxed product B" to the cart
        Then the cart total should be "$442.80"
        And the cart taxes should be "$82.80"

    Scenario: Cart total and taxes are updated after removing one taxed product from the cart
        Given I have added 3 units of product "Taxed product A" to the cart
        And I have added 2 units of product "Taxed product B" to the cart
        When I remove 1 unit of product "Taxed product A" from the cart
        Then the cart total should be "$73.80"
        And the cart taxes should be "$13.80"

    Scenario: Cart total and taxes are updated after changing the quantity of a taxed product
        Given I have added 3 units of product "Taxed product A" to the cart
        And I have added 2 units of product "Taxed product B" to the cart
        When I change the quantity of product "Taxed product A" to 1
        Then the cart total should be "$196.80"
        And the cart taxes should be "$36.80"

        And the product "Symfony Mug" belongs to taxon "Mugs"
        And the product "Sylius Hoodie" belongs to taxon "Hoodies"

    @ui
    Scenario: Receiving a fixed discount when the cart contains enough products from the promoted taxon
        Given there is a promotion "T-Shirts discount" with a fixed discount of "$5.00" for taxon "T-Shirts" with a minimum threshold of "$20.00"
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When the customer views the cart
        Then the discount "T-Shirts discount" should be applied to the order total

    @ui
    Scenario: Not receiving a discount when the cart contains products from a different taxon
        Given there is a promotion "T-Shirts discount" with a fixed discount of "$5.00" for taxon "T-Shirts" with a minimum threshold of "$20.00"
        And the customer added product "Symfony Mug" to the cart
        And the customer added product "Symfony Mug" to the cart
        When the customer views the cart
        Then the discount "T-Shirts discount" should not be applied to the order total

    @ui
    Scenario: Not receiving a discount when the promoted taxon threshold is not met
        Given there is a promotion "T-Shirts discount" with a fixed discount of "$5.00" for taxon "T-Shirts" with a minimum threshold of "$20.00"
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When the customer views the cart
        Then the discount "T-Shirts discount" should not be applied to the order total

    @ui

        Given there is a promotion "T-Shirts discount" with a fixed discount of "$5.00" for taxon "T-Shirts" with a minimum threshold of "$20.00"
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When the customer views the cart
        Then the discount "T-Shirts discount" should be applied once to the order total

    @ui
    Scenario: Receiving all applicable discounts when multiple promotions target different taxons

        And the customer added product "Symfony Mug" to the cart
        When the customer views the cart
        Then the discount "T-Shirts discount" should be applied to the order total
        And the discount "Mugs discount" should be applied to the order total

Feature: Order summary during checkout
  As a Customer
  I want to see the items and quantities in my order summary
  So that I can be certain about the contents of my order before placing it

  Background:
    Given the store operates on a single channel
    And the store has a product "T-Shirt"
    And the store has a product "Mug"
    And the product "T-Shirt" has a variant "T-Shirt - Small"
    And the product "Mug" has a variant "Mug - Default"
    And the product "T-Shirt - Small" is available in the store
    And the product "Mug - Default" is available in the store

  Scenario: The checkout summary page displays all products currently in the cart
    Given I have product "T-Shirt - Small" in the cart with quantity 2
    And I have product "Mug - Default" in the cart with quantity 1
    When I proceed to the checkout summary step
    Then I should see "T-Shirt" in the order summary
    And I should see "Mug" in the order summary
    And I should see "2" as the quantity for "T-Shirt"
    And I should see "1" as the quantity for "Mug"

    And I should see "Mug" in the order summary

    And I should see "3" as the quantity for "Mug"

    When I complete the addressing step
    And I complete the shipping step

    And I should see "2" as the quantity for "T-Shirt"

Feature: Mobile stream pagination
  As a mobile user
  I want to navigate the stream and load more posts on the mobile website
  So that I can browse my stream easily and know when I have reached the end

  Background:
    Given I am on the mobile stream page

  Scenario: User sees a message when there are no posts in the stream
    Given there are no posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    Then I should see "There are no posts yet."
    And I should not see a "More" link

  Scenario: User sees the end of stream message when there are fewer than 15 posts
    Given there are 14 posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    Then I should see "You have reached the end of the stream."
    And I should not see a "More" link

  Scenario: User sees a More link when there are exactly 15 posts
    Given there are 15 posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    Then I should see a "More" link
    And I should not see "You have reached the end of the stream."

  Scenario: User loads the next set of posts when clicking More with exactly 15 posts
    Given there are 30 posts in the stream
    And I have already loaded the first 15 posts
    When I click the "More" link
    Then I should see the next 15 posts in the stream
    And I should see "You have reached the end of the stream."
    And I should not see a "More" link

  Scenario: User sees a More link when there are more than 15 posts
    Given there are 16 posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    Then I should see a "More" link
    And I should not see "You have reached the end of the stream."

  Scenario: User loads additional posts when clicking More with more than 15 posts available

    And I have already loaded the first 15 posts
    When I click the "More" link

    And I should not see a "More" link

        And the zone "European Union" contains the zone "Europe"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

        And the zone "Europe" should not exist in the registry

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Preventing deletion of a zone with associated tax rates
        When I try to delete zone "Asia"
        Then I should be notified that the zone cannot be deleted
        And the zone "Asia" should still exist in the registry

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Preventing deletion of a zone that is a member of another zone

        Then I should be notified that the zone cannot be deleted
        And the zone "Europe" should still exist in the registry

Feature: Preventing payment finalization when tracked stock is insufficient for an existing order
    In order to avoid confirming payments for orders that cannot be fulfilled
    As a Store Administrator
    I want to be prevented from finalizing an order's payment when purchased items do not have sufficient stock

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the store has a product "PHP Mug" priced at "$20.00"
        And the store has an order "000000001" placed by a customer
        And the order contains 2 units of product "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the order payment state is "New"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Blocking payment finalization when a product becomes tracked in inventory with insufficient stock

        Then I should be notified that the payment could not be finalized due to insufficient stock

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Blocking payment finalization when tracked inventory is lower than the ordered quantity

        And the order contains 1 unit of product "PHP Mug"

        And I try to mark the order as paid
        Then I should be notified that the payment could not be finalized due to insufficient stock
        And the order payment state should be "New"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Allowing payment finalization when tracked inventory is sufficient for the ordered quantity

        When I view the summary of order "000000001"
        And I try to mark the order as paid
        Then the order payment state should be "Paid"

@javascript
Feature: hovercards

  Background:
    Given following users exist:
      | username     | email                |
      | Alice Smith  | alice@alice.alice    |
      | Bob Jones    | bob@bob.bob          |
    And I sign in as "alice@alice.alice"
    And I have "Bob Jones" in an aspect called "Besties"

  Scenario: Hover over a user's name in the main stream
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message with hashtags "#music #travel"
    When I hover over "Bob Jones" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"
    And I should see "music" in the hovercard
    And I should see "travel" in the hovercard
    And I should see "Besties" in the hovercard
    And I should see a sharing status icon in the hovercard
    And I should see the tooltip "is sharing with you"
    When I move away from the hovercard
    Then I should not see a hovercard

  Scenario: Hover over a user's avatar in the main stream
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message with hashtags "#music #travel"
    When I hover over "Bob Jones"'s avatar in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"
    And I should see "music" in the hovercard
    And I should see "travel" in the hovercard
    And I should see "Besties" in the hovercard
    When I move away from the hovercard
    Then I should not see a hovercard

  Scenario: Hovercards are not shown for the person who reshared a post
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message with hashtags "#music #travel"
    And I reshare Bob Jones's post
    When I hover over "Alice Smith" in the stream
    Then I should not see a hovercard for "Alice Smith"
    When I hover over "Bob Jones" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"

  Scenario: Hovercards work for tag streams
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message with hashtags "#music #travel"
    When I go to the "#music" tag stream
    And I hover over "Bob Jones" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"
    And I should see "music" in the hovercard
    And I should see "travel" in the hovercard

  Scenario: Hovercards are shown for logged-out users
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message with hashtags "#music #travel"
    And I sign out
    When I hover over "Bob Jones" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"
    And I should see "music" in the hovercard
    And I should see a sharing status icon in the hovercard
    And I should see the tooltip "is not sharing with you"

@javascript
Feature: poll creation

  Background:
    Given following user exists:
      | username    | email             |
      | Alice Smith | alice@alice.alice |
    And I sign in as "alice@alice.alice"

  Scenario: Poll creator panel is hidden by default and can be opened from the publisher
    When I expand the publisher
    Then I should not see the poll creator panel
    When I click the poll creator toggle
    Then I should see the poll creator panel

  Scenario: Add poll options and remove the last option
    When I expand the publisher
    And I click the poll creator toggle
    And I fill in "Poll question" with "Which fruit do you prefer?"
    And I fill in "Option 1" with "Apple"
    And I fill in "Option 2" with "Orange"
    And I blur the "Option 2" field
    Then I should see a third empty poll option field
    When I click the remove icon for the last poll option
    Then I should not see the third poll option field
    And I should not see the remove icon for the last poll option

  Scenario: Post a status update with a poll
    When I expand the publisher
    And I click the poll creator toggle
    And I fill in "Status message" with "Let's vote on dinner"
    And I fill in "Poll question" with "What should we eat?"
    And I fill in "Option 1" with "Pizza"
    And I fill in "Option 2" with "Sushi"
    And I click the publisher submit button
    Then I should see the post in the stream
    And I should see the poll within the stream element

  Scenario: Vote in a poll and see the results summary
    Given there is a poll in the stream
    When I select the poll option "Pizza"
    And I click the vote button
    Then I should see a progress bar for the poll
    And I should see a percentage indicator for the poll
    And I should see "1 vote so far"

  Scenario: Reveal poll results breakdown
    Given there is a poll in the stream
    When I click the toggle-result control
    Then I should see the percentage breakdown of the poll results

  Scenario: Show validation error when submitting a poll with fewer than two options
    When I expand the publisher
    And I click the poll creator toggle
    And I fill in "Status message" with "This poll is incomplete"
    And I fill in "Poll question" with "Which option?"
    And I fill in "Option 1" with "Only one option"
    And I click the publisher submit button
    Then I should see a validation error on the empty answer input field

@catalog_promotion @channel_pricing @product_show
Feature: Display catalog promotion prices only in the channels where the promotion is available
    In order to see the correct product price for my storefront channel
    As a Visitor
    I want catalog promotion prices to be shown only in channels where the promotion is available

    Background:
        Given the store operates multiple channels
        And the "US Web Store" channel has hostname "us.example.com"
        And the "EU Web Store" channel has hostname "eu.example.com"
        And the "US Web Store" channel uses the "USD" currency
        And the "EU Web Store" channel uses the "EUR" currency
        And the store has a configurable product "Sylius T-Shirt"
        And the product "Sylius T-Shirt" has variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Small"
        And the product "Sylius T-Shirt" has variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Medium"
        And the variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Small" has price "100.00" in the "US Web Store" channel
        And the variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Small" has price "90.00" in the "EU Web Store" channel
        And the variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Medium" has price "120.00" in the "US Web Store" channel
        And the variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Medium" has price "110.00" in the "EU Web Store" channel
        And there is a catalog promotion "Summer Sale"
        And the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" is available only in the "US Web Store" channel
        And the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" gives a "20%" discount
        And the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" applies to the product "Sylius T-Shirt"

    Scenario: Visitor sees discounted and original prices in a channel where the catalog promotion is available
        Given I am browsing the store on the "US Web Store" channel
        When I view the product "Sylius T-Shirt"
        Then I should see the discounted price for variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Small" as "80.00"
        And I should see the original price for variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Small" as "100.00"
        And I should see the discounted price for variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Medium" as "96.00"
        And I should see the original price for variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Medium" as "120.00"
        And I should see that the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" is applied

    Scenario: Visitor sees regular channel prices in a channel where the catalog promotion is not available
        Given I am browsing the store on the "EU Web Store" channel
        When I view the product "Sylius T-Shirt"
        Then I should see the regular price for variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Small" as "90.00"
        And I should see the regular price for variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Medium" as "110.00"
        And I should not see any catalog promotion applied
        And I should not see any discounted price for the product "Sylius T-Shirt"

    Scenario: Visitor sees the correct price based on the current storefront channel hostname
        Given I visit "https://us.example.com/products/sylius-t-shirt"
        Then I should be on the "US Web Store" channel
        And I should see the discounted price for variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Small" as "80.00"
        And I should see the original price for variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Small" as "100.00"

    Scenario: Visitor sees no promotion indication in a channel without the promotion
        Given I visit "https://eu.example.com/products/sylius-t-shirt"
        Then I should be on the "EU Web Store" channel
        And I should see the regular price for variant "Sylius T-Shirt - Small" as "90.00"
        And I should not see that the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" is applied

@checkout @addressing @countries @channel
Feature: Restrict available countries on checkout addressing step by channel
    As a Customer
    I want to see only the countries available for my current channel when entering checkout address details
    So that I can choose my country more easily

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And the store has the following countries:
            | name        | code |
            | United States | US  |
            | Poland      | PL  |
            | Germany     | DE  |
        And the store has a product "T-Shirt" priced at "$20.00"
        And the product "T-Shirt" is available in the channel
        And I add product "T-Shirt" to the cart

    @ui
    Scenario: Only channel operating countries are available on the checkout addressing step
        Given the channel "Web" operates in the following countries:
            | country |
            | Poland  |
            | Germany |
        When I proceed to the checkout addressing step
        Then I should see "Poland" in the country list
        And I should see "Germany" in the country list
        And I should not see "United States" in the country list

    @ui
    Scenario: Only the single operating country is available on the checkout addressing step
        Given the channel "Web" operates in the following countries:
            | country |
            | Poland  |
        When I proceed to the checkout addressing step
        Then I should see "Poland" in the country list
        And I should not see "United States" in the country list
        And I should not see "Germany" in the country list

    @ui
    Scenario: All store countries are available when the channel does not define operating countries
        Given the channel "Web" does not define any operating countries
        When I proceed to the checkout addressing step
        Then I should see "United States" in the country list
        And I should see "Poland" in the country list
        And I should see "Germany" in the country list

Feature: View, share, and manage photos on profile pages
  As a user
  I want to view, share, and manage photos on profile pages
  So that I can control who sees my posted photos and maintain privacy over my content

  Background:
    Given I am logged in as "alice@example.com"

  Scenario: A user can view their own posted photos from their profile page
    Given I have posted a photo to my profile
    When I go to my profile page
    And I click on the "Photos" link
    Then I should be on the photos page for "Alice"
    And I should see my posted photo in the photo stream

  Scenario: A user without sharing access does not see the Photos section on another user's profile
    Given "bob@example.com" has posted a photo to his profile
    And I do not have sharing access to Bob's profile
    When I go to Bob's profile page
    Then I should not see the "Photos" section
    And I should not see a "Photos" link

  Scenario: A connected user can see the Photos section for a public photo post
    Given "bob@example.com" has posted a public status message with a photo
    And I share a connection with Bob
    When I go to Bob's profile page
    Then I should see the "Photos" section
    When I click on the "Photos" link
    Then I should be on the photos page for "Bob"
    And I should see Bob's photo in the photo stream

  Scenario: A user can delete their own photo from the photos page
    Given I have posted a photo to my profile
    When I go to my profile page
    And I click on the "Photos" link
    Then I should see my posted photo in the photo stream
    When I delete my photo from the photo stream
    And I confirm the deletion
    Then I should not see the deleted photo in the photo stream

  Scenario: The Photos section disappears after all photos are deleted
    Given I have posted a photo to my profile
    And I have posted another photo to my profile
    When I go to my profile page
    And I click on the "Photos" link
    And I delete my photo from the photo stream
    And I confirm the deletion
    And I delete my other photo from the photo stream
    And I confirm the deletion
    Then I should not see the "Photos" section on my profile page
    And I should not see a "Photos" link

@javascript
Feature: auto follow back

  Background:
    Given following user exists:
      | username    | email             |
      | Alice Smith | alice@alice.alice |
      | Bob Jones   | bob@bob.jones     |
    And I sign in as "alice@alice.alice"
    And I have an aspect named "Friends" with auto follow back enabled

  Scenario: Automatically follow back a user who adds me to an aspect
    Given "Bob Jones" has added me to an aspect
    Then I should automatically add "Bob Jones" to my "Friends" aspect

  Scenario: Do not automatically follow back a previously ignored user
    Given I have ignored "Bob Jones"
    When "Bob Jones" adds me to an aspect
    Then I should not automatically add "Bob Jones" to my "Friends" aspect

  Scenario: Show the auto follow back aspect as selected on a followed user's profile
    Given "Bob Jones" has added me to an aspect
    And I have automatically followed back "Bob Jones"
    When I visit "Bob Jones"'s profile
    Then I should see "Friends" selected in the contact aspect dropdown

  Scenario: Show stop ignoring control for an ignored user
    Given I have ignored "Bob Jones"
    When I visit "Bob Jones"'s profile
    Then I should see a "Stop ignoring" control

@tax_categories
Feature: Editing an existing tax category
  As an Administrator
  I want to edit an existing tax category
  So that I can change its tax classification details without altering its code

  Background:
    Given I am logged in as an administrator
    And there is a tax category "Standard Tax" with code "standard_tax"

  Scenario: Opening an existing tax category for editing
    When I want to edit the tax category "Standard Tax"
    Then I should be on the tax category edit page for "Standard Tax"
    And I should see the tax category code "standard_tax"
    And I should see the tax category name "Standard Tax"

  Scenario: The code of an existing tax category cannot be changed during editing
    Given I am on the edit page for tax category "Standard Tax"
    When I try to change the code to "updated_tax"
    And I save the changes
    Then I should still see the tax category code "standard_tax"
    And the tax category should not be updated with code "updated_tax"

  Scenario: Changing the name of an existing tax category
    Given I am on the edit page for tax category "Standard Tax"
    When I change the name to "Reduced Tax"
    And I save the changes
    Then I should see a success notification
    And the tax category name should be "Reduced Tax"
    And the tax category code should still be "standard_tax"

    In order to evaluate whether a discount is genuine
    As a Customer
    I want to see the lowest price a discounted product was sold at during the previous 30 days

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a channel named "Web"
        And the store operates on a channel named "Mobile"

        And the "lowest price before discount" information is disabled for the "Mobile" channel
        And there is a product "Sylius Mug"
        And the product "Sylius Mug" is available in the "Web" channel
        And the product "Sylius Mug" is available in the "Mobile" channel
        And the product "Sylius Mug" has a regular price of "$20.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Do not display lowest-price-before-discount information when a product has no discount
        When I view the product page for "Sylius Mug" on the "Web" channel
        Then I should not see the lowest price before discount information

    @ui
    Scenario: Display the lowest price within the last 30 days when a product is discounted
        Given the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$18.00" 29 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$16.00" 20 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$19.00" 10 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" is currently discounted to "$15.00"
        When I view the product page for "Sylius Mug" on the "Web" channel
        Then I should see that the lowest price before discount is "$16.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Update the reference price when older price history falls outside the rolling 30-day window
        Given the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$14.00" 31 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$18.00" 29 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$17.00" 5 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" is currently discounted to "$15.00"
        When I view the product page for "Sylius Mug" on the "Web" channel
        Then I should see that the lowest price before discount is "$17.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Do not display lowest-price-before-discount information when a discount is removed and the product returns to its original price
        Given the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$18.00" 20 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" is currently discounted to "$15.00"
        And the product "Sylius Mug" returns to its original price of "$20.00"
        When I view the product page for "Sylius Mug" on the "Web" channel
        Then I should not see the lowest price before discount information

    @ui
    Scenario: Display a new lowest price after the product drops below its original price and a new discount is applied
        Given the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$18.00" 25 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" returned to its original price of "$20.00"
        And the product "Sylius Mug" later dropped to "$17.00"
        And the product "Sylius Mug" is currently discounted to "$16.00"
        When I view the product page for "Sylius Mug" on the "Web" channel
        Then I should see that the lowest price before discount is "$17.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Treat catalog promotions the same as manual price changes when calculating the lowest price before discount
        Given the product "Sylius Mug" had a catalog promotion price of "$19.00" 28 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" had a manual price of "$17.00" 18 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" had a catalog promotion price of "$16.00" 8 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" is currently discounted to "$15.00"
        When I view the product page for "Sylius Mug" on the "Web" channel
        Then I should see that the lowest price before discount is "$16.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Never display lowest-price-before-discount information when the feature is disabled for the channel
        Given the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$18.00" 29 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" had a price of "$16.00" 10 days ago
        And the product "Sylius Mug" is currently discounted to "$15.00"
        When I view the product page for "Sylius Mug" on the "Mobile" channel
        Then I should not see the lowest price before discount information

Feature: Safely editing address book entries containing malicious content
    In order to update my address information safely
    As a Customer
    I want the address book edit form to protect me from script injection

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And I am a logged in customer
        And I have an address book entry with the province value "<script>alert('XSS')</script>"

    @ui
    Scenario: Opening the edit form for an address containing malicious script-like content
        When I open the edit form for my address book entry
        Then the page should render without executing any script
        And there should be no alert popup
        And the province field should display the escaped malicious content

    @ui
    Scenario: Updating an address containing malicious script-like content
        Given I open the edit form for my address book entry
        When I change the province to "Ontario"
        And I save the address
        Then my address should be updated successfully
        And the province should be "Ontario"
        And there should be no alert popup

    @ui
    Scenario: Displaying dangerous characters safely in the edit form
        Given I have an address book entry with the province value "<script>alert('XSS')</script>"
        When I open the edit form for my address book entry
        Then the province value should be escaped or sanitized
        And the page should not execute any injected script

Feature: Manage authorized applications
  As a user
  I want to view and revoke my authorized applications
  So that I can manage which third-party apps have access to my account

  Background:
    Given I am on the mobile website
    And I am signed in

  Scenario: View all authorized applications on the applications page
    Given I have 3 authorized applications
    And the first authorized application has an image
    And the second authorized application has no image
    And the third authorized application has an image
    When I open the applications page
    Then I should see "3 authorized applications"
    And I should see the first authorized application
    And I should see the second authorized application
    And I should see the third authorized application
    And I should see an image for the first authorized application
    And I should not see an image for the second authorized application
    And I should see an image for the third authorized application

  Scenario: Revoke one authorized application from the applications page
    Given I have 2 authorized applications
    And the first authorized application has an image
    And the second authorized application has no image
    When I open the applications page
    Then I should see "2 authorized applications"
    When I revoke the first authorized application
    Then I should see "1 authorized application"
    And I should not see the first authorized application
    And I should see the second authorized application

  Scenario: Revoke all authorized applications from the applications page
    Given I have 2 authorized applications
    And the first authorized application has an image
    And the second authorized application has no image
    When I open the applications page
    Then I should see "2 authorized applications"
    When I revoke the first authorized application
    And I revoke the second authorized application
    Then I should see "0 authorized applications"
    And I should not see any authorized applications

Feature: Preview a post in the stream before publishing
  As a user
  I want to preview my post in the stream before publishing it
  So that I can verify the content and formatting of text, media, mentions, polls, and location without posting it first

  Background:
    Given I am logged in
    And I am on the stream page

  @javascript
  Scenario: Preview a text-only post and see the exact text
    When I expand the publisher
    And I enter "This is a preview test post." into the status message field
    And I click the "Preview" button
    Then I should see the preview area
    And I should see "This is a preview test post." in the preview area

  @javascript
  Scenario: Editing the draft after preview updates the preview content
    When I expand the publisher
    And I enter "Old preview text." into the status message field
    And I click the "Preview" button
    Then I should see "Old preview text." in the preview area
    When I replace the status message with "Updated preview text."
    Then I should see "Updated preview text." in the preview area
    And I should not see "Old preview text." in the preview area

  @javascript
  Scenario: A long status message can be previewed without collapsing
    When I expand the publisher
    And I enter a long status message into the status message field
    And I click the "Preview" button
    Then I should see the preview area
    And the preview area should remain expanded
    And I should see the full long status message in the preview area

  @javascript
  Scenario: After publishing a long message, the posted item is collapsed
    When I expand the publisher
    And I enter a long status message into the status message field
    And I click the "Publish" button
    Then I should see the post in the stream
    And the post should be collapsed

  @javascript
  Scenario: Preview a post with a photo and text
    When I expand the publisher
    And I attach the photo "spec/fixtures/files/image.jpg"
    And I enter "Photo preview text." into the status message field
    And I click the "Preview" button
    Then I should see the preview area
    And I should see "Photo preview text." in the preview area
    And I should see the attached photo in the preview area

  @javascript
  Scenario: Preview a post with a mention and follow the mentioned user from the preview
    Given there is a user named "Alice Example"
    When I expand the publisher
    And I enter "@Alice Example" into the status message field
    And I click the "Preview" button
    Then I should see "@Alice Example" in the preview area as a mention
    And I should see a link to "Alice Example" in the preview area
    When I click the "Alice Example" link in the preview area
    Then I should be on Alice Example's profile page

  @javascript
  Scenario: Preview a post while on a tag page
    Given I am on the tag page for "rails"
    When I expand the publisher
    And I enter "Tag page preview content." into the status message field
    And I click the "Preview" button
    Then I should see the preview area
    And I should see "Tag page preview content." in the preview area

  @javascript
  Scenario: Preview a post with a poll
    When I expand the publisher
    And I add a poll to the post
    And I enter "Which option do you prefer?" into the poll question field
    And I enter "Option 1" into the first poll option field
    And I enter "Option 2" into the second poll option field
    And I click the "Preview" button
    Then I should see the preview area
    And I should see the poll form in the preview area
    And I should see the poll question field in the preview area
    And I should see the first poll option field in the preview area
    And I should see the second poll option field in the preview area

  @javascript
  Scenario: Preview a post with a location
    When I expand the publisher
    And I add a location to the post
    And I enter "123 Main Street, Springfield" into the location field
    And I enter "Location preview text." into the status message field
    And I click the "Preview" button
    Then I should see the preview area
    And I should see the location section in the preview area
    And I should see "123 Main Street, Springfield" in the preview area

  @javascript
  Scenario: Closing and reopening the publisher exits preview mode
    When I expand the publisher
    And I enter "Preview mode reset test." into the status message field
    And I click the "Preview" button
    Then I should see the preview area
    When I close the publisher
    And I reopen the publisher
    Then I should not be in preview mode
    And I should see the status message field
    And I should not see the preview area

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$12.00"

        When I proceed with the checkout addressing step

        Given the channel operates in "United States"
        When I proceed with the checkout addressing step
        Then I should be able to choose only "United States"

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing all countries when the current channel does not define operating countries
        Given the channel does not define any operating countries
        And the store has countries "United States", "Canada" and "Germany"
        When I proceed with the checkout addressing step
        Then I should be able to choose "United States", "Canada" and "Germany"
