@currency @configuration @validation @negative
Feature: Validate currency configuration updates and reject invalid values
  As a system administrator
  I want to validate currency configuration updates and reject invalid values
  So that the system maintains valid configuration data and prevents incorrect currency settings

  Background:
    Given a valid Fineract tenant context
    And the system administrator is authenticated with full configuration management privileges
    And the following currency configuration exists in the system:
      | configKey | configValue | description                         | status |
      | currency   | USD         | Default system currency configuration | ACTIVE |
    And the following supported ISO currency reference data exists:
      | code | numericCode | minorUnit | active |
      | USD  | 840         | 2         | true   |
      | EUR  | 978         | 2         | true   |
      | INR  | 356         | 2         | true   |
    And the following invalid currency payload templates are prepared:
      | scenario                         | requestBodyValue | jsonRepresentation | expectedErrorCode | expectedHttpStatus |
      | empty value                      | ""               | empty string       | currency.invalid  | 400                |
      | NULL value                       | null             | JSON null          | currency.invalid  | 400                |
      | invalid string value             | ABCD             | non-ISO string     | currency.invalid  | 400                |
      | literal string "null" value      | "null"           | string literal     | currency.invalid  | 400                |

  @negative @validation
  Scenario Outline: Reject invalid currency configuration updates
    When the system administrator submits a currency configuration update request with value <jsonRepresentation>
    Then the API response status code should be <expectedHttpStatus>
    And the API response should contain an error code <expectedErrorCode>
    And the API response should contain a validation message indicating the currency value is invalid
    And the currency configuration should remain unchanged with value "USD"

    Examples:
      | scenario                    | jsonRepresentation | expectedErrorCode | expectedHttpStatus |
      | empty value                 | empty string       | currency.invalid  | 400                |
      | NULL value                  | JSON null          | currency.invalid  | 400                |
      | invalid string value        | non-ISO string     | currency.invalid  | 400                |
      | literal string "null" value | string literal     | currency.invalid  | 400                |

  @negative @api @regression
  Scenario: Reject update when currency value is an empty string
    When the system administrator submits a currency configuration update request with value ""
    Then the API response status code should be 400
    And the API response should contain an error code "currency.invalid"
    And the API response should contain a validation message "Currency value must not be empty"
    And the persisted currency configuration should remain "USD"

  @negative @api @regression
  Scenario: Reject update when currency value is NULL
    When the system administrator submits a currency configuration update request with value null
    Then the API response status code should be 400
    And the API response should contain an error code "currency.invalid"
    And the API response should contain a validation message "Currency value must not be null"
    And the persisted currency configuration should remain "USD"

  @negative @api @regression
  Scenario: Reject update when currency value is an invalid string
    When the system administrator submits a currency configuration update request with value "ABCD"
    Then the API response status code should be 400
    And the API response should contain an error code "currency.invalid"
    And the API response should contain a validation message "Currency value must be a valid ISO 4217 currency code"
    And the persisted currency configuration should remain "USD"

  @negative @api @regression
  Scenario: Reject update when currency value is the literal string "null"
    When the system administrator submits a currency configuration update request with value "null"
    Then the API response status code should be 400
    And the API response should contain an error code "currency.invalid"
    And the API response should contain a validation message "Currency value must not be the literal string null"
    And the persisted currency configuration should remain "USD"

    Background:
        Given the store operates in "USD"

        And there is a product "Symfony Mug" priced at "$40.00"
        And there is a product promotion for "PHP T-Shirt" giving "$20.00" off each unit
        And there is an order promotion giving "$10.00" off the order total
        And an order exists containing 2 units of "PHP T-Shirt" and 1 unit of "Symfony Mug"
        And the order promotions have been applied to the order

    Scenario: Administrator views an order summary with original prices, discounted prices, and allocated discounts
        When I view the summary of the order
        Then I should see that the order item for "PHP T-Shirt" has original unit price "$60.00"
        And I should see that the order item for "PHP T-Shirt" has discounted unit price "$36.66"
        And I should see that the order item for "PHP T-Shirt" has quantity "2"
        And I should see that the order item for "PHP T-Shirt" has item discount "-$20.00"
        And I should see that the order item for "PHP T-Shirt" has order discount "-$3.34"
        And I should see that the order item for "PHP T-Shirt" has subtotal "$73.33"

        And I should see that the order item for "Symfony Mug" has original unit price "$40.00"
        And I should see that the order item for "Symfony Mug" has discounted unit price "$36.67"
        And I should see that the order item for "Symfony Mug" has quantity "1"
        And I should see that the order item for "Symfony Mug" has item discount "$0.00"
        And I should see that the order item for "Symfony Mug" has order discount "-$3.33"
        And I should see that the order item for "Symfony Mug" has subtotal "$36.67"

        And the "PHP T-Shirt" order item should reflect the product promotion in its item discount

    Scenario: Administrator sees that order-wide promotions are distributed proportionally across order items

Feature: Down payment allocation, overpayment reallocation, reversals, and loan-level configurability
  As a Loan Officer
  I want the loan system to correctly handle down payment calculations, allocations, and reversals when loans become overpaid due to multiple disbursements, and to control down payment configurability at the loan level based on product-level settings
  So that overpaid amounts are accurately reallocated against subsequent disbursements, loan balances and repayment schedules remain correct after transaction reversals, and down payment behavior consistently respects the rules defined at the product level

  Background:
    Given the following loan products exist:
      | productCode | productName                         | currency | principal | interestRatePerAnnum | termFrequency | termFrequencyType | amortizationType | interestType | repaymentEvery | repaymentEveryType | multiDisburseLoan | allowPartialPeriodInterestCalc | enableDownPayment | defaultAutoDownPaymentPercentage | allowCustomAutoDownPaymentPercentage | accountingRule |

      | LP-NODP-002  | Standard Product No Down Payment    | USD      | 5000.00   | 10.00                | 10            | Months            | EqualInstallments| Declining    | 1              | Months             | true             | true                          | false            | 0.00                             | false                                | ACCRUAL        |

Feature: Prevent changing payment method for cancelled orders
    As a Customer
    I want to be prevented from changing the payment method of a cancelled order
    So that I can only perform valid operations on orders that are no longer active

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And there is a customer "john@example.com" identified by email "john@example.com"
        And the customer "john@example.com" is logged in
        And there is a cancelled order "00000001" placed by customer "john@example.com"
        And the order "00000001" has payment method "Bank transfer"
        And the order "00000001" has shipping method "DHL"
        And the order "00000001" contains a product "T-Shirt" priced at "$20.00"

    Scenario: Customer can browse the details of a cancelled order
        When the customer browses the details of order "00000001"
        Then they should see that the order "00000001" is cancelled
        And they should see the payment method "Bank transfer"
        And they should see the shipping method "DHL"
        And they should see the product "T-Shirt"

    Scenario: Customer is blocked from changing the payment method of a cancelled order
        When the customer tries to change the payment method of order "00000001" to "Credit card"
        Then the payment method of order "00000001" should remain "Bank transfer"
        And the customer should be notified that the payment method can no longer be changed for that order
        And the customer should stay on the order details page for order "00000001"

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has "United States", "Canada" and "Germany" available as countries
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$12.00"

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing only the countries available for the current channel
        Given the channel operates in "United States" and "Canada"
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When the customer proceeds to the checkout addressing step
        Then they should be able to choose only "United States" and "Canada" as countries

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing only one country when the current channel defines a single operating country
        Given the channel operates in "United States"
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When the customer proceeds to the checkout addressing step
        Then they should be able to choose only "United States" as a country

    @ui
    Scenario: Seeing all store countries when the current channel does not define operating countries
        Given the channel does not define any operating countries
        And the customer added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When the customer proceeds to the checkout addressing step
        Then they should be able to choose "United States", "Canada" and "Germany" as countries

@managing_products
Feature: Selecting a product main taxon from the current panel locale

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has taxons "Men-T-Shirts_PL", "Woman-T-Shirts_PL", "Men-T-Shirts_FR", "Woman-T-Shirts_FR", "Men-T-Shirts_DE", "Woman-T-Shirts_DE", "Woman-T-Shirts_UA"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario Outline: Selecting a main taxon from the current panel locale
        Given I am in the "<locale>" locale
        When I choose the main taxon for the product
        Then I should be able to select taxons "<available_taxons>"
        And I should not be able to select taxon "Woman-T-Shirts_UA"

        Examples:
            | locale | available_taxons                         |
            | Polish | Men-T-Shirts_PL, Woman-T-Shirts_PL      |
            | French | Men-T-Shirts_FR, Woman-T-Shirts_FR      |
            | German | Men-T-Shirts_DE, Woman-T-Shirts_DE      |

Feature: Accept invitation and complete account registration

  As a new user who has received an invitation from an existing member
  I want to accept the invitation and complete my account registration
  So that I can join the platform and immediately connect with the person who invited me

  Background:
    Given an existing user "alice@alice.alice" has sent an invitation to a new user
    And the invited user has opened the invitation acceptance page

  Scenario: New user accepts invitation and creates an account
    When the invited user fills in the new user form with valid registration details
    And the invited user presses "Create account"
    Then the user should see a "welcome to diaspora" confirmation message
    And the new user should be able to connect with the inviting user "alice@alice.alice"

  Scenario: New user selects an aspect after account creation
    Given the invited user has successfully created an account
    When the user selects "Family" from the "user_aspects" dropdown within "#hello-there"
    Then the "user_aspects" dropdown within "#hello-there" should display "Family"

    I want to see the items and quantities in my order summary

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the store has a product "PHP Mug" priced at "$20.00"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui

        Then I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "2" in my order summary
        And I should see "PHP Mug" with quantity "1" in my order summary

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the updated cart contents in the checkout summary page

        And I added 3 products "PHP Mug" to the cart

        Then I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "1" in my order summary
        And I should see "PHP Mug" with quantity "3" in my order summary

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the order summary after completing the addressing step
        Given I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        When I complete the addressing step
        And I check the order summary
        Then I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "1" in my order summary

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the order summary after completing the shipping step
        Given I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I complete the addressing step
        When I complete the shipping step
        And I check the order summary
        Then I should see "PHP T-Shirt" with quantity "1" in my order summary

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Seeing the order summary after completing the payment step
        Given I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I complete the addressing step
        And I complete the shipping step
        When I complete the payment step
        And I check the order summary

@managing_zones
Feature: Deleting zones from the registry

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a zone "Europe"
        And the store has a zone "North America"
        And the store has a tax rate "VAT" for zone "North America"
        And the zone "Europe" is a member of zone "North America"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario: Successfully deleting a zone with no dependencies
        When I delete the zone "Europe"
        Then I should be notified that the zone has been deleted
        And I should not see zone "Europe" in the registry

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to delete a zone that has associated tax rates
        When I try to delete the zone "North America"
        Then I should be informed that the zone cannot be deleted
        And I should see zone "North America" in the registry

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to delete a zone that is a member of another zone
        When I try to delete the zone "Europe"
        Then I should be informed that the zone cannot be deleted
        And I should see zone "Europe" in the registry

Feature: Mobile stream pagination
  As a mobile user
  I want to navigate the stream and load more posts on the mobile website
  So that I can browse my stream easily and know when I have reached the end

  Background:
    Given I am on the mobile stream page

  Scenario: User sees a message when there are no posts in the stream
    Given there are no posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    Then I should see "There are no posts yet."

  Scenario: User sees the end of stream message when there are fewer than 15 posts
    Given there are 14 posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    Then I should see "You have reached the end of the stream."
    And I should not see a "More" link

  Scenario: User sees a More link when there are exactly 15 posts
    Given there are 15 posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    Then I should see a "More" link
    And I should not see "You have reached the end of the stream."

  Scenario: User loads the next set of posts when clicking More with exactly 15 posts
    Given there are 15 posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    And I click the "More" link
    Then I should see the next set of posts
    And I should see "You have reached the end of the stream."

  Scenario: User sees a More link when there are more than 15 posts
    Given there are 16 posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    Then I should see a "More" link
    And I should not see "You have reached the end of the stream."

  Scenario: User loads additional posts when clicking More with more than 15 posts available
    Given there are 30 posts in the stream
    When I view the stream
    And I click the "More" link
    Then I should see additional posts
    And I should see "You have reached the end of the stream."

    Given the store operates on multiple channels

    And the "Web-EU" channel has "Euro" as its base currency

    And the exchange rate from "US Dollar" to "British Pound" is "0.7" for the "Web-US" channel
    And the exchange rate from "Polish Zloty" to "US Dollar" is "0.23" for the "Web-US" channel
    And the exchange rate from "British Pound" to "Bhutanese Ngultrum" is "1.15" for the "Web-EU" channel

    And I should not see the exchange rate from "British Pound" to "Bhutanese Ngultrum"

@checkout @addressing @shipping-address-only
Feature: Checkout addressing with shipping address only
  In order to complete checkout quickly
  As a customer
  I want to provide only a shipping address when my channel requires it
  So that I do not need to enter redundant billing information

  Background:
    Given the store operates on a channel that requires only a shipping address
    And there is a product "T-Shirt" available in the store
    And the product "T-Shirt" has a single variant priced at "$20.00"
    And the customer has product "T-Shirt" in the cart
    And the customer is on the checkout addressing step

  Scenario: Customer completes the addressing step with only a shipping address
    When the customer fills in the shipping address with:
      | first name | John          |
      | last name  | Doe           |
      | street     | 123 Main Street |
      | city       | New York      |
      | postcode   | 10001         |
      | country    | United States |
    And the customer submits the addressing form
    Then the customer should be on the checkout shipping step
    And the checkout should not require a billing address

  Scenario: Addressing step accepts a complete shipping address
    When the customer fills in the shipping address with:
      | first name | Jane          |
      | last name  | Smith         |
      | street     | 45 Market Road |
      | city       | London        |
      | postcode   | SW1A 1AA      |
      | country    | United Kingdom |
    And the customer submits the addressing form
    Then the shipping address should be saved
    And the customer should be on the checkout shipping step

  Scenario: Customer is not asked to provide a billing address when only shipping address is required
    When the customer fills in the shipping address with:
      | first name | Alice         |
      | last name  | Brown         |
      | street     | 10 King Street |
      | city       | Paris         |
      | postcode   | 75001         |
      | country    | France        |
    And the customer submits the addressing form

    And the customer should be on the checkout shipping step

    In order to buy only valid items for the store I am browsing
    As a Customer
    I want to only add products and variants that are available in the current channel

        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store also operates on another channel in "Canada"

        And it belongs to "United States"
        And the store has a product "Symfony Mug" priced at "$20.00"
        And it belongs to "Canada"

        And it belongs to "United States"
        And the store has a variant "PHP Hoodie - Small" priced at "$120.00"
        And it belongs to "United States"
        And the store has a variant "PHP Hoodie - Large" priced at "$130.00"
        And it belongs to "Canada"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Being informed that a simple product from another channel does not exist

        When I try to add product "Symfony Mug" to the cart
        Then I should be informed that the product does not exist
        And my cart should be empty

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Being informed that a variant from another channel does not exist
        Given I browse products in the "United States" channel
        When I try to add variant "PHP Hoodie - Large" to the cart
        Then I should be informed that the product does not exist

  and fall back to safe default values for undefined jobs

      | jobName  | partitionSize | chunkSize | retryLimit |

    And the default batch job property values are defined as:
      | propertyName  | defaultValue |
      | partitionSize  | 1            |
      | chunkSize      | 1            |
      | retryLimit     | 1            |
    And the Property Service is initialized without any runtime errors

Feature: Apply promotion coupons with per-customer usage limits
    In order to receive the correct discount
    As a Customer
    I want to apply a promotion coupon to my cart only when it is valid for my account and usage history

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And the store has a product "T-Shirt" priced at "$20.00"
        And the store has a promotion "Summer discount" with coupon code "SUMMER10"
        And the promotion gives "$10.00" discount to the cart
        And the promotion coupon "SUMMER10" has a per-customer usage limit of 1
        And the store has a customer "john@example.com"
        And the customer "john@example.com" is logged in
        And the customer has product "T-Shirt" in the cart

    @ui @promotion @coupon
    Scenario: Logged-in customer applies a valid coupon and receives the discount
        When the customer applies coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should be applied to the cart
        And the cart total should be "$10.00"
        And the customer should receive a "$10.00" discount

    @ui @promotion @coupon
    Scenario: A coupon remains valid until the per-customer usage limit is reached
        Given the customer has not used coupon "SUMMER10" before
        When the customer applies coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should be applied to the cart
        And the cart total should be "$10.00"

    @ui @promotion @coupon
    Scenario: Customer cannot receive the discount again after reaching the coupon usage limit
        Given the customer has already used coupon "SUMMER10" once in a completed order
        And the customer has product "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should not be applied to the cart
        And no discount should be applied
        And the cart total should remain "$20.00"

    @ui @promotion @coupon
    Scenario: A completed order using the coupon counts toward the customer's usage limit
        Given the customer has placed and completed an order using coupon "SUMMER10"
        And the customer has product "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should not be applied to the cart
        And no discount should be applied
        And the cart total should remain "$20.00"

    @ui @promotion @coupon
    Scenario: A cancelled order does not count toward the customer's usage limit by default
        Given the customer has placed and cancelled an order using coupon "SUMMER10"
        And the promotion is configured to ignore cancelled orders for coupon usage limits
        And the customer has product "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should be applied to the cart
        And the cart total should be "$10.00"

    @ui @promotion @coupon
    Scenario: A cancelled order counts toward the customer's usage limit when configured as non-reusable
        Given the customer has placed and cancelled an order using coupon "SUMMER10"
        And the promotion is configured to treat cancelled orders as non-reusable
        And the customer has product "T-Shirt" in the cart
        When the customer applies coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
        Then the coupon "SUMMER10" should not be applied to the cart
        And no discount should be applied
        And the cart total should remain "$20.00"

    @ui @promotion @coupon
    Scenario: Cart total reflects the discount when the coupon is valid
        Given the customer has not used coupon "SUMMER10" before
        When the customer applies coupon "SUMMER10" to the cart
        Then the cart total should be "$10.00"
        And the discount line should show "$10.00"

    @ui @promotion @coupon
    Scenario: Cart total remains unchanged when the coupon is invalid due to usage limits

    I want to edit existing zones by changing their name, priority, and members

        And the store has a zone "Europe" with priority "1"

        And it contains the province "California"
        And it contains the zone "Nordic Countries"

        Then I should be notified that the zone has been updated
        And the zone "Europe" should contain the country "France"
        And the zone "Europe" should not contain the country "Germany"

    @ui
    Scenario: Removing multiple countries from a zone and adding one back
        When I want to edit the zone "Europe"
        And I remove the country "France"
        And I remove the country "Germany"
        And I add the country "Germany"
        And I save my changes
        Then I should be notified that the zone has been updated
        And the zone "Europe" should not contain the country "France"
        And the zone "Europe" should contain the country "Germany"

    @ui
    Scenario: Removing a province from an existing zone
        When I want to edit the zone "Europe"
        And I remove the province "California"
        And I save my changes
        Then I should be notified that the zone has been updated
        And the zone "Europe" should not contain the province "California"

    @ui
    Scenario: Removing a nested zone from an existing zone

        And I remove the zone "Nordic Countries"
        And I save my changes
        Then I should be notified that the zone has been updated
        And the zone "Europe" should not contain the zone "Nordic Countries"

    @ui

        And I rename it to "European Union"
        And I save my changes
        Then I should be notified that the zone has been updated
        And the zone name should be "European Union"

    @ui
    Scenario: Changing the priority of an existing zone
        When I want to edit the zone "Europe"

        And I save my changes
        Then I should be notified that the zone has been updated

  Background:
    Given following user exists:
      | username    | email             |
      | Alice Smith | alice@alice.alice |

    And I confirm the reshare prompt
    Then I should see a flash message containing "successfully"
    And I should not see "Reshare" in the feedback area for "A public post to reshare"

  Scenario: Reshare a public post from another user's profile page
    When I visit "Bob Jones"'s profile page
    And I click "Reshare" on "A public post to reshare"
    And I confirm the reshare prompt
    Then I should see a flash message containing "successfully"
    And I should not see "Reshare" in the feedback area for "A public post to reshare"

    Then I should see a flash message containing "successfully"
    And I should not see "Reshare" in the feedback area for "A public post to reshare"

Feature: Display customer's IP address on placed orders
    In order to know from which IP address a new order was placed
    As an Administrator
    I want to see the customer's IP address on placed orders

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And the store has a product "T-Shirt" priced at "$20.00"
        And the store has a customer "john@example.com"
        And the store has a shipping method "DHL Courier"
        And the store has a payment method "Offline"
        And the customer "john@example.com" has product "T-Shirt" in the cart
        And the customer "john@example.com" has chosen "DHL Courier" shipping method
        And the customer "john@example.com" has chosen "Offline" payment method

    @ui
    Scenario: Customer IP address is stored when an order is placed through the UI
        Given the customer "john@example.com" is browsing from IP address "192.168.10.25"
        When the customer confirms and places the order
        Then the order should be placed successfully
        And the order should store the customer's IP address "192.168.10.25"

    @ui
    Scenario: Administrator can see the customer's IP address in the order summary
        Given the customer "john@example.com" is browsing from IP address "192.168.10.25"
        And the customer confirms and places the order
        When the administrator views the summary of the placed order
        Then the order summary should contain the customer's IP address "192.168.10.25"

    @api
    Scenario: Customer IP address is stored when an order is placed through the API
        Given the API client sends an order placement request from IP address "203.0.113.42"
        When the order is created successfully via the API
        Then the created order should store the customer's IP address "203.0.113.42"

    @api
    Scenario: Administrator can see the customer's IP address for an order created through the API
        Given an order was created successfully via the API from IP address "203.0.113.42"
        When the administrator views the summary of the placed order
        Then the order summary should contain the customer's IP address "203.0.113.42"

    @ui @api
    Scenario Outline: Newly placed orders expose the customer's IP address in both UI and API contexts
        Given the order is placed from IP address "<ip_address>" using "<context>"
        When the administrator views the summary of the placed order
        Then the order summary should contain the customer's IP address "<ip_address>"

        Examples:
            | context | ip_address      |
            | UI      | 192.168.10.25   |
            | API     | 203.0.113.42    |

Feature: Increasing promotion coupon usage after order placement

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a promotion "Holiday Sale" with coupon "HOLIDAY10"
        And the promotion coupon "HOLIDAY10" has usage count 0
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Increasing promotion coupon usage after a customer places an order using a coupon
        When a customer places an order using the promotion coupon "HOLIDAY10"
        Then the promotion coupon "HOLIDAY10" usage count should be 1
        And I should see that the promotion coupon "HOLIDAY10" usage count is 1 when browsing all coupons for promotion "Holiday Sale"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Increasing promotion coupon usage for multiple successful orders using the same coupon
        When a customer places an order using the promotion coupon "HOLIDAY10"
        And another customer places an order using the promotion coupon "HOLIDAY10"
        Then the promotion coupon "HOLIDAY10" usage count should be 2
        And I should see that the promotion coupon "HOLIDAY10" usage count is 2 when browsing all coupons for promotion "Holiday Sale"

Feature: Catalog promotions are reflected in variant pricing
  In order to show accurate promotional pricing to customers
  As a Store Manager
  I want catalog promotions to be automatically applied to eligible product variants

  Background:
    Given the store operates on the "default" channel
    And there is a configurable product "T-Shirt"
    And the product "T-Shirt" has a variant "T-Shirt - Medium"
    And the variant "T-Shirt - Medium" has an original price of "$100.00"

  Scenario: Display the discounted price for an eligible product variant
    Given there is an active catalog promotion "Summer Sale"
    And the catalog promotion "Summer Sale" applies a "20%" discount to the variant "T-Shirt - Medium"
    When I view the variant "T-Shirt - Medium"
    Then I should see the original price "$100.00"
    And I should see the discounted price "$80.00"
    And I should see the catalog promotion name "Summer Sale" next to the discounted price

  Scenario: Show both original and discounted prices when a catalog promotion is applied
    Given there is an active catalog promotion "Black Friday Deal"
    And the catalog promotion "Black Friday Deal" applies a "15%" discount to the variant "T-Shirt - Medium"
    When I view the variant "T-Shirt - Medium"
    Then I should see the original price "$100.00"
    And I should see the discounted price "$85.00"
    And I should see the catalog promotion name "Black Friday Deal" alongside the discounted price

  Scenario: Do not change the displayed price when no catalog promotion is applicable
    Given there is no active catalog promotion for the variant "T-Shirt - Medium"
    When I view the variant "T-Shirt - Medium"
    Then I should see the original price "$100.00"
    And I should not see any discounted price
    And I should not see any catalog promotion name

Feature: NSFW profile and content visibility on mobile
  As a mobile user
  I want to mark my content as not safe for work (NSFW) and control the visibility of NSFW content from others
  So that I can protect sensitive content and choose whether to view potentially objectionable material from people I follow

  Background:
    Given I am logged in as a mobile user
    And I am on the mobile home page

  @javascript
  Scenario: Mark my profile as NSFW from the edit profile page
    Given I am on my edit profile page
    When I check the "profile[nsfw]" checkbox
    And I press "Update profile"
    Then the "profile[nsfw]" checkbox should be checked
    And I should see a confirmation that my profile was updated

  @javascript
  Scenario: Mark my profile as safe for work from the edit profile page
    Given I am on my edit profile page
    And the "profile[nsfw]" checkbox is checked
    When I uncheck the "profile[nsfw]" checkbox
    And I press "Update profile"
    Then the "profile[nsfw]" checkbox should not be checked
    And I should see a confirmation that my profile was updated

  @javascript
  Scenario Outline: Hide NSFW posts by default in another user's mobile stream
    Given <post_type> content exists from an NSFW user
    And I am viewing another user's mobile stream
    Then the NSFW post should be hidden by default
    And I should not see the post text
    And I should not see the poll text
    And I should not see the location indicator
    And I should not see the picture

    Examples:
      | post_type |
      | text      |
      | poll      |
      | location  |
      | picture   |

  @javascript
  Scenario Outline: Show previously hidden NSFW posts after toggling NSFW visibility
    Given <post_type> content exists from an NSFW user
    And I am viewing another user's mobile stream
    And the NSFW post is hidden by default
    When I toggle NSFW visibility on
    Then the NSFW post should be visible
    And I should see the post text
    And I should see the poll text
    And I should see the location indicator
    And I should see the picture

    Examples:
      | post_type |
      | text      |
      | poll      |
      | location  |
      | picture   |

  @javascript
  Scenario Outline: Resharing an NSFW post keeps the reshare active and hidden by default on the home page
    Given an NSFW user has posted a <post_type> post
    And I am viewing that post on mobile
    When I reshare the post
    Then the reshare action should be active
    And the reshared post should be counted as an NSFW post
    When I go to my mobile home page
    Then the reshared NSFW post should be hidden by default
    And I should not see the post text
    And I should not see the poll text
    And I should not see the location indicator
    And I should not see the picture

    Examples:
      | post_type |
      | poll      |
      | location  |
      | picture   |

Feature: Notifications for activity related to me
  As a user
  I want to receive and manage notifications for activity related to me
  So that I can stay informed about interactions on my posts, profile, and connections

  Background:
    Given I am logged in as "alice@example.com"
    And I have an aspect named "Friends"
    And I have a post visible to my aspect "Friends"

  @notifications @sharing
  Scenario: I receive a notification and email when someone starts sharing with me
    Given "bob@example.com" starts sharing with me
    When I open the notifications dropdown in the header
    Then I should see a notification for "bob@example.com" starting to share with me
    And the notification should be unread
    When I visit the notifications page
    Then I should see a notification for "bob@example.com" starting to share with me
    And I should have received 1 email delivery

  @notifications @reshare
  Scenario: I receive a notification and email when someone reshared my post
    Given "bob@example.com" reshared my post
    When I open the notifications dropdown in the header
    Then I should see a notification for "bob@example.com" reshared my post
    And the notification should be unread
    And I should have received 1 email delivery

  @notifications @like
  Scenario: I receive a notification and email when someone likes my post
    Given "bob@example.com" liked my post
    When I open the notifications dropdown in the header
    Then I should see a notification for "bob@example.com" liking my post
    And the notification should be unread
    And I should have received 1 email delivery

  @notifications @comment
  Scenario: I receive a notification and email when someone comments on my post
    Given "bob@example.com" commented on my post
    When I open the notifications dropdown in the header
    Then I should see a notification for "bob@example.com" commenting on my post
    And the notification should be unread
    And I should have received 1 email delivery

  @notifications @also_commented_on
  Scenario: I receive an also commented on notification and the correct number of email deliveries when someone replies in a conversation involving my post
    Given "bob@example.com" commented on my post
    And "carol@example.com" replied to "bob@example.com"'s comment on my post
    When I open the notifications dropdown in the header
    Then I should see an "also commented on" notification for "carol@example.com"
    And I should have received 2 email deliveries

  @notifications @mention @post
  Scenario: I receive a notification and email when someone mentions me in a post
    Given "bob@example.com" mentioned me in a post
    When I open the notifications dropdown in the header
    Then I should see a notification for "bob@example.com" mentioning me in a post
    And the notification should be unread
    And I should have received 1 email delivery

  @notifications @mention @comment
  Scenario: I receive a notification and email when someone mentions me in a comment
    Given "bob@example.com" mentioned me in a comment
    When I open the notifications dropdown in the header
    Then I should see a notification for "bob@example.com" mentioning me in a comment
    And the notification should be unread
    And I should have received 1 email delivery

@managing_zones
Feature: Creating and editing zones with proper validation

    Background:
        Given I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to add a zone without a code
        When I try to create a new zone without specifying its code
        Then I should be informed that code is required

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to add a zone with a code that is too long
        When I try to create a new zone with a code that is too long
        Then I should be informed that the code is too long

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to add a zone without a name
        When I try to create a new zone without specifying its name
        Then I should be informed that name is required

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to add a zone without any members
        When I try to create a new zone without adding any members
        Then I should be informed that at least one zone member is required

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to change the type when creating a country zone
        When I try to create a new country zone
        Then the type field should be disabled
        And the type should be fixed to country

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to change the type when creating a province zone
        When I try to create a new province zone
        Then the type field should be disabled
        And the type should be fixed to province

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to edit the code of an existing zone
        Given there is a zone "Europe"
        When I try to edit this zone
        Then the code should not be editable

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to add a zone as its own member
        Given there is a zone "Europe"
        When I try to edit this zone and add it as its own member
        Then I should be informed that the zone cannot be added as its own member

    @ui
    Scenario: Being unable to add an invalid country code to a country zone
        When I try to create a country zone with an invalid country code

  As a Loan Officer
  I want the system to automatically generate an additional (N+1) installment when a charge is added to a loan after its maturity date
  So that fees applied after the original repayment schedule has ended are still properly tracked, billed, and can be collected without disrupting the existing installment history

        And the order total should remain "$12.00"

Feature: Search users and hashtags from the search input
  In order to quickly find people and topics
  As a user
  I want to search for other users and hashtags directly from the search input

  Background:
    Given I am logged in

  @search @users
  Scenario: Matching users appear in the dropdown when typing a partial username
    Given "Alice Wonderland" exists with diaspora handle "alice@example.org"
    When I enter "ali" into the search input
    Then I should see a dropdown result for "Alice Wonderland"
    When I click the dropdown result for "Alice Wonderland"
    Then I should be on the profile page for "Alice Wonderland"

  @search @users
  Scenario: Submitting a username with no exact match redirects to the users search results page
    When I enter "no_such_user_123" into the search input
    And I submit the search
    Then I should be on the users search results page for "no_such_user_123"
    And I should see the page title "Users matching no_such_user_123"

  @search @users @federated
  Scenario: Federated users discovered in the background appear with diaspora handle and add-to-aspect option
    Given a federated user "user@pod.tld" has been discovered in the background
    When I search for "user@pod.tld"
    Then I should see a search result showing the diaspora handle for "user@pod.tld"
    And I should see an option to add "user@pod.tld" to an aspect

  @search @users @privacy
  Scenario: Users marked as not searchable do not appear to unrelated users
    Given "Private Person" exists with diaspora handle "private@example.org"
    And "Private Person" has marked their profile as not searchable
    And I am not connected to "Private Person"
    When I search for "private"
    Then I should not see a search result for "Private Person"

  @search @users @privacy
  Scenario: Users marked as not searchable appear once a connection exists
    Given "Private Person" exists with diaspora handle "private@example.org"
    And "Private Person" has marked their profile as not searchable
    And I am connected to "Private Person"
    When I search for "private"
    Then I should see a search result for "Private Person"

  @search @hashtags
  Scenario: Matching hashtags appear in the dropdown when typing a hashtag
    Given the hashtag "#Matrix" exists
    When I enter "#Matrix" into the search input
    Then I should see a dropdown result for "#Matrix"
    When I click the dropdown result for "#Matrix"
    Then I should be on the tag page for "#Matrix"

Feature: Prevent finalizing payment for orders with insufficient tracked stock
  In order to avoid confirming payments for orders that cannot be fulfilled
  As a store administrator
  I want to be prevented from marking an order as paid when a purchased item becomes stock-tracked after purchase and has insufficient inventory

  Background:
    Given the store operates with inventory tracking enabled
    And there is a product "T-Shirt" available in the catalog
    And there is a customer "John Doe"
    And there is an order placed by "John Doe" containing 3 units of "T-Shirt"
    And the order payment state is "New"

  Scenario: Blocking payment finalization when tracked stock is lower than the ordered quantity
    Given the product "T-Shirt" was not tracked in inventory when the order was placed
    And the product "T-Shirt" is now tracked in inventory
    And there are only 2 units of "T-Shirt" available in stock
    When the administrator views the order summary for this order
    And the administrator attempts to mark the order as paid
    Then the payment should not be finalized
    And the administrator should be notified that the payment could not be finalized due to insufficient stock
    And the order payment state should remain "New"

  Scenario: Allowing payment finalization when tracked stock is sufficient
    Given the product "T-Shirt" was not tracked in inventory when the order was placed
    And the product "T-Shirt" is now tracked in inventory
    And there are 3 units of "T-Shirt" available in stock
    When the administrator views the order summary for this order
    And the administrator attempts to mark the order as paid
    Then the payment should be finalized successfully
    And the order payment state should be "Paid"

Feature: Spring Batch job-specific configuration properties resolution
  As a System Administrator
  I want the Spring Batch infrastructure to correctly read job-specific configuration properties
  and fall back to safe default values for undefined jobs
  So that batch jobs like LOAN_COB can be executed with the correct performance and resilience settings,
  while unrecognized job configurations do not cause failures or unpredictable behavior

  Background:
    Given the Spring Batch Property Service is initialized
    And the following batch job configuration properties are available in the system

      | jobName   | partitionSize | chunkSize | retryLimit | configurationStatus |
      | LOAN_COB  | 100           | 100       | 5          | CONFIGURED          |

    And the following safe default batch property values are defined

      | propertyName   | defaultValue |
      | partitionSize  | 1            |
      | chunkSize      | 1            |
      | retryLimit     | 1            |

  @batch @property-service @loan-cob
  Scenario: Resolve configured batch properties for LOAN_COB job
    When the partition size is fetched for the "LOAN_COB" job
    And the chunk size is fetched for the "LOAN_COB" job
    And the retry limit is fetched for the "LOAN_COB" job
    Then the partition size should be 100
    And the chunk size should be 100
    And the retry limit should be 5
    And no exception should be thrown during property resolution
    And the job should be identified as configured

  @batch @property-service @fallback
  Scenario Outline: Resolve safe default batch properties for an unconfigured or invalid job
    When the <propertyName> is fetched for the "<jobName>" job
    Then the <propertyName> should be <expectedValue>
    And no exception should be thrown during property resolution
    And the job should be identified as unconfigured

    Examples:
      | jobName      | propertyName  | expectedValue |
      | INVALID_JOB  | partition size | 1             |
      | INVALID_JOB  | chunk size     | 1             |
      | INVALID_JOB  | retry limit    | 1             |

  @batch @property-service @validation
  Scenario: Distinguish configured jobs from invalid jobs without failing
    When the partition size is fetched for the "LOAN_COB" job
    And the partition size is fetched for the "INVALID_JOB" job
    Then the "LOAN_COB" job should resolve to configured values
    And the "INVALID_JOB" job should resolve to default values
    And the Property Service should not throw any runtime error
    And the Property Service should not return null for any requested property

  I want to be prevented from marking an order as paid when a purchased item becomes stock-tracked after purchase and has insufficient inventory

@javascript
Feature: hovercards

  Background:
    Given following user exists:
      | username     | email              |
      | Alice Smith  | alice@alice.alice  |
      | Bob Jones    | bob@bob.bob        |
    And I sign in as "alice@alice.alice"
    And I have "Bob Jones" in aspect "Besties"

  Scenario: Hover over a user's name in the main stream
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message
    When I hover over "Bob Jones" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"
    And I should see "Besties" in the hovercard
    And I should see the sharing status icon in the hovercard
    And I should see the sharing status tooltip "is sharing with you"
    When I move away from the hovercard
    Then I should not see a hovercard

  Scenario: Hover over a user's avatar in the main stream
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message
    When I hover over the avatar for "Bob Jones" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"
    And I should see the profile tags in the hovercard
    When I move away from the hovercard
    Then I should not see a hovercard

  Scenario: Hovercards are shown for the original poster of a reshare
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message
    And Alice Smith reshares Bob Jones's post
    When I hover over "Bob Jones" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"
    When I hover over "Alice Smith" in the reshare
    Then I should not see a hovercard

  Scenario: Hovercards work in a tag stream
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message with the tag "#music"
    When I go to the "#music" tag stream
    And I hover over "Bob Jones" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"
    And I should see the sharing status icon in the hovercard
    When I move away from the hovercard
    Then I should not see a hovercard

  Scenario: Hovercards work for a logged-out user
    Given Bob Jones posts a public message
    And I sign out
    When I hover over "Bob Jones" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"
    And I should not see "Besties" in the hovercard
    And I should see the sharing status icon in the hovercard
    And I should see the sharing status tooltip "is not sharing with you"

@applying_promotion_rules
Feature: Receiving discount with a promotion coupon based on customer usage history
    In order to receive the correct discount without exceeding coupon usage limits
    As a Customer
    I want to apply a promotion coupon to my cart only when it is valid for my account and usage history

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And the store has a promotion "Cart coupon promotion"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving discount when applying a valid coupon for the first time
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off when coupon code is "SAVE20"
        And the coupon "SAVE20" can be used once per customer
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "SAVE20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$80.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving discount when the coupon usage limit has not been reached yet
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off when coupon code is "SAVE20"
        And the coupon "SAVE20" can be used twice per customer
        And I have already used coupon "SAVE20" once in a completed order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "SAVE20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$80.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Receiving no discount when the coupon usage limit has been reached
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off when coupon code is "SAVE20"
        And the coupon "SAVE20" can be used once per customer
        And I have already used coupon "SAVE20" once in a completed order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "SAVE20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$100.00"
        And there should be no discount applied

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Counting a completed order toward the coupon usage limit
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off when coupon code is "SAVE20"
        And the coupon "SAVE20" can be used once per customer
        And I have already used coupon "SAVE20" once in a completed order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "SAVE20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$100.00"
        And there should be no discount applied

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Not counting a cancelled order toward the coupon usage limit by default
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off when coupon code is "SAVE20"
        And the coupon "SAVE20" can be used once per customer
        And I have already used coupon "SAVE20" once in a cancelled order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "SAVE20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$80.00"
        And my discount should be "-$20.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Counting a cancelled order toward the coupon usage limit when cancelled orders are non-reusable
        Given the promotion gives "$20.00" off when coupon code is "SAVE20"
        And the coupon "SAVE20" can be used once per customer
        And the promotion treats cancelled orders as non-reusable
        And I have already used coupon "SAVE20" once in a cancelled order
        When I add product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I apply coupon "SAVE20" to my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$100.00"
        And there should be no discount applied

        And the second payment method should be "Bank transfer"

            | cash_on_deliv | Cash on delivery  | 10       |
        When I browse payment methods

        And the first payment method should have position 5
        And the last payment method should have position 15

            | code          | name              | position |
            | bank_transfer | Bank transfer     | 50       |
            | cash_on_deliv | Cash on delivery  | 0        |
            | credit_card   | Credit card       | 100      |
        When I browse payment methods
        Then the first payment method should be "Cash on delivery"

    Scenario: The payment method with the highest position appears last in the list

            | code          | name              | position |
            | bank_transfer | Bank transfer     | 1        |
            | cash_on_deliv | Cash on delivery  | 10       |
            | credit_card   | Credit card       | 99       |
        When I browse payment methods
        Then the last payment method should be "Credit card"

            | cash_on_deliv | Cash on delivery  |          |

        When I browse payment methods

        And the last payment method should be "Cash on delivery"

  I want to edit and update my profile information including personal details, tags, privacy settings, and photo
  So that I can keep my profile accurate, up to date, and personalized

  Background:
    Given I am a registered user
    And I am logged in
    And I am on my profile edit page

  Scenario: Update personal profile fields and see saved values reflected in the form
    When I select "Female" from the gender field
    And I fill in "First name" with "Alicia"
    And I fill in "Last name" with "Stone"
    And I fill in "Bio" with "Updated bio text for my profile"
    And I fill in "Location" with "Berlin, Germany"
    And I fill in "Date of birth" with "1990-05-12"
    And I press "Save"
    Then I should see a success confirmation message
    And the gender field should contain "Female"
    And the first name field should contain "Alicia"
    And the last name field should contain "Stone"
    And the bio field should contain "Updated bio text for my profile"
    And the location field should contain "Berlin, Germany"
    And the date of birth field should contain "1990-05-12"

  Scenario: Add multiple tags and keep them visible after saving and returning to the form
    When I search for the tag "ruby"
    And I select the tag "ruby"
    And I search for the tag "rails"
    And I select the tag "rails"
    And I search for the tag "testing"
    And I select the tag "testing"
    And I press "Save"
    Then I should see a success confirmation message
    And I should see the tag "ruby"
    And I should see the tag "rails"
    And I should see the tag "testing"
    When I return to the profile edit page
    Then I should see the tag "ruby"
    And I should see the tag "rails"
    And I should see the tag "testing"

  Scenario: Toggle public details and persist the updated privacy setting
    When I turn the "Public details" switch off
    And I press "Save"
    Then I should see a success confirmation message
    And the "Public details" switch should be off
    When I return to the profile edit page
    Then the "Public details" switch should be off
    When I turn the "Public details" switch on
    And I press "Save"
    Then I should see a success confirmation message
    And the "Public details" switch should be on
    When I return to the profile edit page
    Then the "Public details" switch should be on

  Scenario: Upload an invalid profile photo file and see an error message
    When I attach the file "spec/fixtures/files/invalid_profile_photo.txt" to "Profile photo"
    And I press "Save"
    Then I should see an error message for invalid photo upload
    And my profile photo should not be updated

  Scenario: Upload, crop, preview, and confirm a valid profile photo
    When I attach the file "spec/fixtures/files/profile_photo.jpg" to "Profile photo"
    Then I should see the photo crop interface
    When I crop the photo
    And I preview the cropped photo
    Then I should see the cropped photo preview
    When I confirm the photo upload
    And I press "Save"
    Then I should see a success confirmation message
    And my profile photo should be displayed on my profile page

    And I should see "Builder" in the "profile_last_name" field
    And I should see "I build things" in the "profile_bio" field
    And I should see "Berlin" in the "profile_location" field
    And I should see "1985-04-12" in the "profile_date_of_birth" field

Feature: Manage a person's aspects from their profile page on mobile

  As a mobile website user
  I want to add or remove people from my aspects directly from their profile page
  So that I can organize my contacts into meaningful groups and easily manage those relationships

  Background:
    Given I am logged in as "alice"
    And I am using the mobile website
    And "bob" is a person I can view on their profile page
    And I have an aspect named "Friends"
    And I have an aspect named "Work"

  Scenario: Show "Add contact" when the viewed person is not in any aspect
    Given "bob" is not in any of my aspects
    When I visit "bob"'s profile page
    Then I should see the author info section
    And within ".author-info" I should see the aspect dropdown
    And the aspect dropdown should show "Add contact"

  Scenario: Add a person to an aspect from their profile page
    Given "bob" is not in any of my aspects
    When I visit "bob"'s profile page
    And I open the aspect dropdown within ".author-info"
    And I select "Friends" from the aspect dropdown
    Then "bob" should be in the "Friends" aspect
    And the aspect dropdown should show "Friends"
    And the "Friends" aspect contact count should increase by 1

  Scenario: Show the total aspect count when a person belongs to more than one aspect
    Given "bob" is in the "Friends" aspect
    And "bob" is in the "Work" aspect
    When I visit "bob"'s profile page
    Then within ".author-info" I should see the aspect dropdown
    And the aspect dropdown should show "In 2 aspects"

  Scenario: Persist aspect membership and contact count after revisiting the profile page
    Given "bob" is not in any of my aspects
    When I visit "bob"'s profile page
    And I open the aspect dropdown within ".author-info"
    And I select "Friends" from the aspect dropdown
    Then "bob" should be in the "Friends" aspect
    And the "Friends" aspect contact count should increase by 1
    When I visit "bob"'s profile page again
    Then the aspect dropdown should show "Friends"
    And the "Friends" aspect contact count should remain increased by 1

  Scenario: Remove a person from an aspect by selecting the same aspect again
    Given "bob" is in the "Friends" aspect
    When I visit "bob"'s profile page
    And I open the aspect dropdown within ".author-info"
    And I select "Friends" from the aspect dropdown
    Then "bob" should not be in the "Friends" aspect
    And the aspect dropdown should show "Add contact"
    And the "Friends" aspect contact count should decrease by 1

  Scenario: Remove one aspect when a person belongs to multiple aspects
    Given "bob" is in the "Friends" aspect
    And "bob" is in the "Work" aspect
    When I visit "bob"'s profile page
    And I open the aspect dropdown within ".author-info"
    And I select "Friends" from the aspect dropdown
    Then "bob" should not be in the "Friends" aspect
    And "bob" should still be in the "Work" aspect
    And the aspect dropdown should show "Friends"
    And the "Friends" aspect contact count should decrease by 1
    And the "Work" aspect contact count should remain unchanged

@catalog_promotion
Feature: Enabling and disabling catalog promotions
    In order to control which promotional discounts are currently applied to products
    As an Administrator
    I want to enable or disable catalog promotions

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And there is a catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Disabling an active catalog promotion
        Given the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" gives "$20.00" off products "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" is active
        When I disable the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion"
        Then the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" should be inactive
        And the discount should not be applied to product "PHP T-Shirt"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Enabling a disabled catalog promotion during its operating period
        Given the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" gives "$20.00" off products "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" is disabled
        And the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" is currently within its operating period
        When I enable the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion"
        Then the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" should be active
        And the discount should be applied to product "PHP T-Shirt"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Enabling a catalog promotion before its start date
        Given the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" gives "$20.00" off products "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" is disabled
        And the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" starts in the future
        When I enable the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion"
        Then the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" should be inactive
        And the discount should not be applied to product "PHP T-Shirt"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Enabling a catalog promotion after its end date
        Given the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" gives "$20.00" off products "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" is disabled
        And the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" has already ended
        When I enable the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion"
        Then the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" should be inactive
        And the discount should not be applied to product "PHP T-Shirt"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Keeping a catalog promotion inactive outside its operating period
        Given the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" gives "$20.00" off products "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" is active
        And the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" is outside its operating period
        When I check the details of the product "PHP T-Shirt"
        Then the catalog promotion "T-Shirts promotion" should be inactive
        And the discount should not be applied to product "PHP T-Shirt"

Feature: Deleting zones from the registry
    In order to keep the list of zones accurate and free of unused entries
    As a store administrator
    I want to delete zones from the registry

    Background:
        Given I am logged in as an administrator
        And there is a zone named "Europe"
        And there is a zone named "North America"
        And there is a tax rate "Standard VAT" associated with the "Europe" zone
        And there is a zone named "EU Countries"
        And the "Europe" zone is a member of the "EU Countries" zone

    @ui @javascript
    Scenario: Successfully deleting a zone with no dependencies
        Given there is a zone named "Asia"
        When I browse zones
        And I delete the "Asia" zone
        Then I should see a confirmation message saying "Zone has been successfully deleted."
        And the "Asia" zone should no longer appear in the list of zones

    @ui @javascript
    Scenario: Preventing deletion of a zone that has associated tax rates
        When I browse zones
        And I delete the "Europe" zone
        Then I should see a notification saying "Cannot delete the zone because it is used by one or more tax rates."
        And the "Europe" zone should still appear in the list of zones

    @ui @javascript
    Scenario: Preventing deletion of a zone that is a member of another zone
        When I browse zones
        And I delete the "North America" zone

    Given I am logged in

  @TestRailId:C76707

Feature: Mobile navigation via header menu and drawer
  As a mobile website user
  I want to navigate between different pages using the header menu and the drawer navigation
  So that I can quickly access the content and features relevant to my role and preferences without confusion

  Background:
    Given I am on the mobile website
    And I am logged in

  @navigation @stream
  Scenario: Clicking the header title from the activity stream page navigates to the stream page
    Given I am on the activity stream page
    When I click the header title
    Then I should be on the stream page

  @navigation @notifications
  Scenario: Clicking the notification badge navigates to the notifications page
    Given I am on the activity stream page
    When I click the notification badge
    Then I should be on the notifications page

  @navigation @conversations
  Scenario: Clicking the conversations badge navigates to the conversations page
    Given I am on the activity stream page
    When I click the conversations badge
    Then I should be on the conversations page

  @navigation @publisher
  Scenario: Clicking the compose badge navigates to the new status message page
    Given I am on the activity stream page
    When I click the compose badge
    Then I should be on the new status message page

  @drawer @search @users @tags
  Scenario: Searching in the drawer finds users and tags
    Given I open the drawer navigation
    Then I should see a search input in the drawer
    When I search for "alice"
    Then I should see matching users in the search results
    When I search for "#ruby"
    Then I should be navigated to the tag page for "ruby"

  @drawer @navigation
  Scenario Outline: Drawer links navigate to the correct pages
    Given I open the drawer navigation
    When I click the "<link_name>" link in the drawer
    Then I should be on the "<destination_page>" page

    Examples:
      | link_name      | destination_page   |
      | Stream         | stream             |
      | My Activity    | my activity        |
      | Mentions       | mentions           |
      | Aspects        | aspects            |
      | Profile        | profile            |
      | Contacts       | contacts           |
      | Settings       | settings           |

  @aspects @stream
  Scenario: Viewing an aspect shows only posts from that aspect

    And I have multiple aspects with posts in each aspect
    When I select the "Friends" aspect
    Then I should only see posts belonging to the "Friends" aspect in the main stream
    When I select the "Work" aspect
    Then I should only see posts belonging to the "Work" aspect in the main stream

  @tags @follow

    When I click the "rails" tag in the Followed tags section

@viewing_exchange_rates
Feature: Viewing exchange rates available in the current channel
    In order to be aware of currency conversion rates relevant to the shop I am using
    As a Customer
    I want to view the exchange rates available in my current channel

    Background:
        Given the store operates on multiple channels
        And the store has a channel "Web-US" with base currency "US Dollar"
        And the store has a channel "Web-UK" with base currency "British Pound"
        And the store has a channel "Web-PL" with base currency "Polish Zloty"
        And the channel "Web-US" allows the currencies "US Dollar", "British Pound" and "Polish Zloty"
        And the channel "Web-UK" allows the currencies "British Pound" and "Bhutanese Ngultrum"
        And the channel "Web-PL" allows the currencies "Polish Zloty" and "US Dollar"
        And there is an exchange rate from "US Dollar" to "British Pound" with value 0.7
        And there is an exchange rate from "Polish Zloty" to "US Dollar" with value 0.23
        And there is an exchange rate from "British Pound" to "Bhutanese Ngultrum" with value 110.00
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Viewing exchange rates for the current channel
        When I switch my current channel to "Web-US"
        And I view the exchange rates for my current channel
        Then I should see 2 exchange rates in the list
        And I should see the exchange rate from "US Dollar" to "British Pound" with value 0.7
        And I should see the exchange rate from "Polish Zloty" to "US Dollar" with value 0.23
        And I should not see the exchange rate from "British Pound" to "Bhutanese Ngultrum"

        Given the store operates on a single channel
        And the store has the following countries:
            | name    | code |
            | Belgium | BE   |
            | France  | FR   |
            | Germany | DE   |
        And the store has a product "T-Shirt"
        And the product "T-Shirt" is available in the channel
        And I add product "T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I proceed to checkout

    @ui

        Given the channel "Web" has the following operating countries:
            | country |
            | Belgium |
            | France  |

        Then I should only be able to choose the following countries:
            | country |
            | Belgium |
            | France  |
        And I should not be able to choose country "Germany"

    @ui
    Scenario: Only the single operating country is available on the checkout addressing step

            | country |
            | Belgium |
        When I go to the checkout addressing step
        Then I should only be able to choose the following countries:
            | country |
            | Belgium  |
        And I should not be able to choose country "France"
        And I should not be able to choose country "Germany"

            | Belgium |
            | France  |
            | Germany |

        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$12.00"

        And the store has a product "Sylius Cap" priced at "£20.00"
        And the customer placed an order for "PHP T-Shirt" in "USD" with a total of "$12.00"
        And the customer placed an order for "Symfony Mug" in "EUR" with a total of "€15.00"
        And the customer placed an order for "Sylius Cap" in "GBP" with a total of "£20.00"
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @ui
    Scenario: Filtering orders by currency
        When I filter orders by currency "EUR"

        And I should see the order placed in "EUR"
        And I should not see the order placed in "USD"
        And I should not see the order placed in "GBP"

    @ui
    Scenario: Filtering orders by total greater than a specified amount in a selected currency
        When I filter orders by currency "USD" and total greater than "$10.00"
        Then I should see 1 order in the list
        And I should see the order with total "$12.00"
        And I should not see the order placed in "EUR"
        And I should not see the order placed in "GBP"

    @ui
    Scenario: Filtering orders by total less than a specified amount in a selected currency
        When I filter orders by currency "GBP" and total less than "£25.00"

        And I should not see the order placed in "USD"

    When I move the mouse away from the hovercard

Feature: reshare public posts

  Background:
    Given following user exists:
      | username    | email             |
      | Alice Smith | alice@alice.alice |
      | Bob Jones   | bob@bob.bob       |
    And I sign in as "alice@alice.alice"
    And "Bob Jones" has a public post with text "A public post to reshare"

  Scenario: Reshare a public post from the stream
    When I am on the stream
    And I click "Reshare" on "A public post to reshare"
    And I confirm the reshare prompt
    Then I should see a flash message containing "successfully"
    And I should not see "Reshare" in the feedback area for "A public post to reshare"

  Scenario: Reshare a public post from the author's profile page
    When I am on "Bob Jones"'s profile page
    And I click "Reshare" on "A public post to reshare"
    And I confirm the reshare prompt
    Then I should see a flash message containing "successfully"
    And I should not see "Reshare" in the feedback area for "A public post to reshare"

  Scenario: Reshare a public post from the single post view
    When I am on the single post view for "A public post to reshare"
    And I click "Reshare" on "A public post to reshare"
    And I confirm the reshare prompt
    Then I should see a flash message containing "successfully"
    And I should not see "Reshare" in the feedback area for "A public post to reshare"

  Scenario: Do not show reshare option again for a post already reshared on the author's profile
    Given I have reshared "A public post to reshare"
    When I am on "Bob Jones"'s profile page
    Then I should not see "Reshare" in the feedback area for "A public post to reshare"

  Scenario: Show deleted original post message on a reshare
    Given I have reshared "A public post to reshare"
    And "Bob Jones" deletes the original post "A public post to reshare"
    When I am on the stream
    Then I should see "Original post deleted by author"

Feature: View a public profile and public post comments on mobile
  As a visitor browsing Diaspora on a mobile device
  I want to view a user's public profile page along with their public posts and comments
  So that I can access shared content without needing to log in

  Background:
    Given I am logged out
    And I am using a mobile device

  Scenario: View a public profile page and see the public post text
    When I visit the public profile page for "alice"
    Then I should see the user's profile header
    And I should see the public post text within ".stream .post-content"

  Scenario: Reveal comments for a public post
    When I visit the public profile page for "alice"
    And I click on the "show comments" element within ".stream .post"
    Then I should see the comments section within ".stream .post"
    And I should see previously submitted comments for the public post

  Scenario: Display previously submitted comments correctly on a public post

    And I click on the "show comments" element within ".stream .post"
    Then I should see the comment text "This is a public comment" within ".stream .post .comments"
    And I should see the comment author "bob" within ".stream .post .comments"
