@cart_page_protection
Feature: Preventing cart modifications on a completed order
    In order to avoid corrupting a completed order
    As a Customer
    I want the cart page to reject any changes once my order has been completed in the background

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$100.00"
        And I am a logged in customer
        And I added product "PHP T-Shirt" to the cart
        And I proceeded to checkout
        And I completed my order in the background

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Preventing cart clearing on a stale cart page after the order has been completed
        When I try to clear my cart from the stale cart page
        Then the completed order should still exist
        And the completed order checkout state should be "completed"
        And the completed order should still contain product "PHP T-Shirt"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Preventing item removal on a stale cart page after the order has been completed
        When I try to remove product "PHP T-Shirt" from the stale cart page
        Then the completed order should still exist
        And the completed order checkout state should be "completed"
        And the completed order should still contain product "PHP T-Shirt"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Preventing quantity changes on a stale cart page after the order has been completed
        When I try to increase the quantity of product "PHP T-Shirt" on the stale cart page
        Then the completed order should still exist
        And the completed order checkout state should be "completed"
        And the quantity of product "PHP T-Shirt" in the completed order should remain "1"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Preventing cart modifications on a stale page even after reloading the page
        When I reload the stale cart page
        And I try to remove product "PHP T-Shirt" from the cart
        Then the completed order should still exist
        And the completed order checkout state should be "completed"
        And the completed order should still contain product "PHP T-Shirt"

        Then I should be notified that the removal operation has started successfully

@javascript
Feature: hovercards

  Background:
    Given following users exist:
      | username     | email                |
      | Alice Smith  | alice@alice.alice    |
      | Bob Jones    | bob@bob.bob          |
      | Carol White  | carol@carol.carol    |
    And Alice Smith has a public post with the text "Hello from Alice"
    And Bob Jones reshared Alice Smith's public post
    And Alice Smith has the tags "#music #ruby"
    And I have added "Alice Smith" to the aspect "Besties"

  Scenario: Show and hide a hovercard for a user's name in the main stream
    When I hover over "Alice Smith" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Alice Smith"
    And I should see the tags "#music #ruby" in the hovercard
    And I should see the aspect "Besties" in the hovercard
    And I should see a sharing status icon in the hovercard
    And I should see the tooltip "is sharing with you" in the hovercard
    When I move away from the hovercard
    Then I should not see a hovercard for "Alice Smith"

  Scenario: Show a hovercard for the original poster of a reshared post
    When I hover over "Alice Smith" in the reshared post
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Alice Smith"
    And I should not see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"

  Scenario: Do not show a hovercard for the resharing user
    When I hover over "Bob Jones" in the reshared post
    Then I should not see a hovercard for "Bob Jones"

  Scenario: Show hovercards in a tag stream for a logged-in user
    Given I am on the "#ruby" tag stream
    When I hover over "Alice Smith" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Alice Smith"
    And I should see the tags "#music #ruby" in the hovercard

  Scenario: Show hovercards in a tag stream for a logged-out user
    Given I am not signed in
    And I am on the "#ruby" tag stream
    When I hover over "Alice Smith" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Alice Smith"
    And I should see the tags "#music #ruby" in the hovercard

  Scenario: Show a hovercard with a not sharing status
    Given Carol White has a public post with the text "Hello from Carol"
    When I hover over "Carol White" in the stream
    Then I should see a hovercard for "Carol White"
    And I should see a sharing status icon in the hovercard
    And I should see the tooltip "is not sharing with you" in the hovercard

Feature: oembed rich media previews

  Background:
    Given following user exists:
      | username    | email             |
      | Alice Smith | alice@alice.alice |
    And I sign in as "alice@alice.alice"

  Scenario: Post a secure video link from a supported oEmbed provider
    When I click the publisher and post "[title](https://example.com/file.ogv)"
    Then I should see a HTML5 video player

  Scenario: Post an unsecure video link
    When I click the publisher and post "[title](http://example.com/file.ogv)"
    Then I should see the raw link text within the stream element
    And I should not see a HTML5 video player

  Scenario: Post an unsecure rich media link from a non-secure source
    When I click the publisher and post "[title](http://example.com/video)"
    Then I should see the raw link text within the stream element
    And I should not see a HTML5 video player

  Scenario: Post a direct photo link
    When I click the publisher and post "[title](https://example.com/photo.jpg)"
    Then I should see an image within the stream element

  Scenario: Post a link from a domain that does not support oEmbed
    When I click the publisher and post "[title](https://example.com/page)"
    Then I should see the raw link text within the stream element
    And I should not see an embedded preview

Feature: Mobile private conversations
  As a mobile user
  I want to send, view, and delete private conversation messages with my connections on the mobile website
  So that I can communicate privately with other users and manage my message history while on a mobile device

  Background:
    Given I am using the mobile website
    And I am signed in

  Scenario: Send a new private message to a connection and view it in the conversation
    Given I am on the new private message page
    When I select a connection as the recipient
    And I fill in "Subject" with "Mobile private message"
    And I fill in "Message" with "Hello, this is a private message from mobile."
    And I press "Send message"
    Then I should see "Mobile private message" in the conversation heading
    And I should see the recipient in the active conversation
    And I should see "Hello, this is a private message from mobile." in the conversation stream

  Scenario: Recipient replies to an existing private conversation
    Given there is an existing private conversation with "Mobile private message"
    And I sign out
    And I sign in as the recipient
    When I open the private conversation titled "Mobile private message"
    And I fill in "Message" with "Thanks, I got your message."
    And I press "Reply"
    Then I should see "Thanks, I got your message." in the conversation stream

  Scenario: Delete a message from a private conversation
    Given there is an existing private conversation with "Mobile private message"
    And I am viewing the conversation titled "Mobile private message"
    When I click the remove action for the message "Hello, this is a private message from mobile."
    And I confirm the deletion prompt
    Then I should not see "Hello, this is a private message from mobile." in the conversation stream

Feature: Applying correct taxes to products in the same tax category
    In order to see and pay the proper total amount for my order
    As a Customer
    I want to have correct taxes applied to my cart for products in the same tax category

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a tax category "Standard"
        And the store has a tax rate "23%" for "Standard"
        And the store has a product "Taxed Product A" priced at "$100.00"
        And it belongs to "Standard"
        And the store has a product "Taxed Product B" priced at "$30.00"
        And it belongs to "Standard"
        And I am a logged in customer

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Applying taxes to a single taxed product
        When I add product "Taxed Product A" to the cart
        And I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$123.00"
        And my cart taxes should be "$23.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Applying taxes to multiple units of the same taxed product
        When I add 3 products "Taxed Product A" to the cart
        And I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$369.00"
        And my cart taxes should be "$69.00"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Applying taxes to multiple taxed products in the same tax category
        When I add 3 products "Taxed Product A" to the cart
        And I add 2 products "Taxed Product B" to the cart
        And I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$442.80"
        And my cart taxes should be "$82.80"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Recalculating taxes after removing one taxed product from the cart
        Given I added 3 products "Taxed Product A" to the cart
        And I added 2 products "Taxed Product B" to the cart
        When I remove one product "Taxed Product A" from the cart
        And I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$73.80"
        And my cart taxes should be "$13.80"

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Recalculating taxes after changing the quantity of a taxed product
        Given I added 3 products "Taxed Product A" to the cart
        And I added 2 products "Taxed Product B" to the cart
        When I change quantity of product "Taxed Product A" to 1
        And I check the details of my cart
        Then my cart total should be "$196.80"
        And my cart taxes should be "$36.80"

@order @admin @api @ui
Feature: Display customer's IP address on placed orders
  In order to know from which IP address a new order was placed
  As an Administrator
  I want to see the customer's IP address on placed orders

  Background:
    Given the store operates on a single channel
    And there is a customer account "john@example.com"
    And there is a product "T-Shirt" priced at "$20.00"
    And the customer has this product in the cart

  @ui
  Scenario: Customer's IP address is stored when an order is placed through the shop UI
    Given the customer is browsing the store from IP address "192.168.10.25"
    When the customer confirms and places the order
    Then the order should be placed successfully
    And the order should store the customer's IP address as "192.168.10.25"

  @ui
  Scenario: Administrator can see the customer's IP address in the order summary in the admin panel
    Given the customer placed an order from IP address "192.168.10.25"
    And I am logged in as an administrator
    When I view the summary of the placed order
    Then I should see the customer's IP address "192.168.10.25"

  @api
  Scenario: Customer's IP address is stored when an order is placed through the API
    Given the customer is making an API request from IP address "203.0.113.42"
    And the customer has this product in the cart via the API
    When the customer confirms and places the order via the API
    Then the order should be created successfully
    And the order should store the customer's IP address as "203.0.113.42"

  @api
  Scenario: Administrator can see the customer's IP address in the order summary for an API-created order
    Given the customer placed an order via the API from IP address "203.0.113.42"
    And I am logged in as an administrator
    When I view the summary of the placed order
    Then I should see the customer's IP address "203.0.113.42"

  @ui @api
  Scenario Outline: Newly placed orders store the customer's IP address regardless of the context
    Given the customer is placing an order from IP address "<ipAddress>" in the "<context>" context
    When the customer confirms and places the order
    Then the order should be placed successfully
    And the order should store the customer's IP address as "<ipAddress>"

    Examples:
      | context | ipAddress       |
      | UI      | 192.168.10.25   |
      | API     | 203.0.113.42    |

  I want to use the aspect navigation menu to select and deselect one or more aspects and have my selection remembered across pages
  So that I can filter which posts I see and target posts to specific aspects

  Background:
    Given I am logged in as a diaspora user
    And I have the following aspects:
      | name      |
      | Friends   |
      | Family    |
      | Work      |
      | Acquaintances |

  Scenario: All aspects are selected by default when opening the aspects page
    When I go to the aspects page
    Then I should see the aspect navigation menu
    And all aspects should be selected
    And the following aspects should be selected:
      | name          |
      | Friends       |
      | Family        |
      | Work          |
      | Acquaintances |

  Scenario: I can select only one aspect
    Given I am on the aspects page
    When I deselect all aspects
    And I select the "Friends" aspect
    Then only the "Friends" aspect should be selected
    And the following aspects should be unselected:
      | name          |
      | Family        |
      | Work          |
      | Acquaintances |

  Scenario: I can add additional aspects to my selection
    Given I am on the aspects page
    When I deselect all aspects
    And I select the "Friends" aspect
    And I select the "Family" aspect
    Then the following aspects should be selected:
      | name    |
      | Friends |
      | Family  |
    And the following aspects should be unselected:
      | name          |
      | Work          |
      | Acquaintances |

  Scenario: My aspect selection is preserved when navigating away and returning
    Given I am on the aspects page
    When I deselect all aspects
    And I select the "Friends" aspect
    And I select the "Work" aspect
    And I go to the stream page
    And I go to the contacts page
    And I return to the aspects page
    Then the following aspects should be selected:
      | name    |
      | Friends |
      | Work    |
    And the following aspects should be unselected:
      | name          |
      | Family        |
      | Acquaintances |

  Scenario: I can deselect all aspects
    Given I am on the aspects page
    When I select the "Friends" aspect
    And I select the "Family" aspect
    And I select the "Work" aspect
    And I click "Deselect all"
    Then all aspects should be unselected
    And the following aspects should be unselected:
      | name          |
      | Friends       |
      | Family        |
      | Work          |
      | Acquaintances |

Feature: Returning an order payment state to awaiting payment after gateway cancellation

    Background:
        Given the store operates on a single channel in "United States"
        And the store has a product "PHP T-Shirt" priced at "$12.00"
        And the customer bought a single "PHP T-Shirt"
        And the customer placed an order
        And the order has an authorized payment
        And I am logged in as an administrator

    @api @ui
    Scenario: Returning the order payment state to awaiting payment after the authorized payment is cancelled by the gateway
        When the authorized payment is cancelled by the gateway
        Then the order payment state should be "Awaiting payment"
        And I should be able to see the order in the orders list
        When I view the summary of the order
        Then the order should contain 2 payments

      | WC_Loan          | m_wc_loan            | wc_loan_single_audit          | single-row | true       | false   | exposes wc_loan_id as PK/unique/indexed                                |
      | WC_Loan          | m_wc_loan            | wc_loan_multi_events          | multi-row  | true       | false   | exposes wc_loan_id as FK/indexed                                      |
